column7: Many people are commenting on this online.

column3: To evaluate or assess, with some measure: 风险评估 "risk assessment", 评估价值, 对…进行评估. It is more formal and methodical than 估计, and the result is a judgment, often written. The 古 in 估 sounds like gǔ, close to gū.
column4: 专家正在评估这个项目的风险。
column5: 專家正在評估這個項目的風險。
column6: Zhuānjiā zhèngzài pínggū zhège xiàngmù de fēngxiǎn.
column7: Experts are assessing the risks of this project.

column3: To release or issue something officially: 发布消息 "announce news", 发布新产品, 新品发布会 "product launch". The source is an organization or a person with authority, and the content is information or a product. 发 is also the simplified form of 髮 "hair" (fà), but here it is 發, "send out".
column4: 公司发布了一款新手机。
column5: 公司發布了一款新手機。
column6: Gōngsī fābù le yī kuǎn xīn shǒujī.
column7: The company released a new phone.

column3: To issue or publish in quantity: 发行股票 "issue shares", 发行邮票 "issue stamps", 发行量 "circulation", 发行新书. It is for books, discs, films, stamps, money and bonds, sent out into circulation. 发布 is for announcing, while 发行 is for putting products out. Here 行 is xíng.
column4: 这本书将在下个月发行。
column5: 這本書將在下個月發行。
column6: Zhè běn shū jiāng zài xià ge yuè fāxíng.
column7: This book will be published next month.

column3: To advocate or promote an idea, formal: 倡导环保 "advocate protecting the environment", 倡导者 "advocate". It is often a person or organization who leads and others follow. 倡 is a person 亻 with 昌 "bright", leading the way, and 导 is a hand 寸 guiding.
column4: 学校倡导大家少用塑料袋。
column5: 學校倡導大家少用塑膠袋。
column6: Xuéxiào chàngdǎo dàjiā shǎo yòng sùliàodài.
column7: The school encourages everyone to use fewer plastic bags.

column3: To encourage or promote a practice as a good thing: 提倡节约 "promote thrift", 提倡读书, 大力提倡 "strongly advocate". The subject is usually the government, school or society, and the object a habit or value. More common than 倡导, which is more formal. 提 "raise" and 倡 "advocate".
column4: 政府提倡大家坐公共交通。
column5: 政府提倡大家坐公共交通。
column6: Zhèngfǔ tíchàng dàjiā zuò gōnggòng jiāotōng.
column7: The government encourages everyone to take public transport.

column3: To communicate so that both sides understand each other: 沟通能力 "communication skills", 和孩子沟通, 有效沟通. It is two-way and about mutual understanding, not just sending information. 沟 is a ditch (氵 "water"), so the idea is a channel opened between two parties, and 通 means "through".
column6: Fùmǔ yào duō hé háizi gōutōng.
column7: Parents should talk with their children more.

column3: To get in touch with: 保持联络 "keep in touch", 联络方式 "contact details", 联络员 "liaison". It is somewhat more formal than 联系, which in speech is the usual word on the mainland; in Taiwan 聯絡 is common in speech. Both characters have a thread or link idea, as 络 has 纟.
column6: Dào le yǐhòu qǐng gēn wǒ liánluò.
column7: Please get in touch with me when you arrive.

column3: An official public announcement or notice: 发布公告, 公告栏 "bulletin board", 招标公告 "tender notice". It comes from a government body, school or company, in contrast to 启事, which an individual can post. 公 is 八 "divide" over 厶 "private": what is shared with all.
column4: 公司在网站上发布了一则公告。
column5: 公司在網站上發布了一則公告。
column6: Gōngsī zài wǎngzhàn shàng fābù le yī zé gōnggào.
column7: The company posted an announcement on its website.

column3: To analyze: 分析原因, 数据分析, 分析问题. You break something into parts to understand it. This is just what the characters show: 分 is 八 "divide" with a knife 刀 and 析 is an axe 斤 splitting wood 木, so both mean "split".
column6: Wǒmen xiān fēnxī yīxià yuányīn.
column7: Let us first analyze the cause.

column3: All, without exception: it follows the group it counts and comes before the verb: 他们全都来了, 这些我全都看过. Slightly stronger than 都 alone. 全 shows jade 玉 put away 入 whole and unharmed, hence "entire".
column6: Zhèxiē shū wǒ quándōu kànguò.
column7: I have read all of these books.

column3: For the most part, mostly: 大都是学生 "mostly students", 大都已经离开了. It states that most of a group does something, with a few exceptions. It means the same as 大多. Read dàdōu; 大都 can also be dàdū "a big city".
column4: 来参加的人大都是学生。
column5: 來參加的人大都是學生。
column6: Lái cānjiā de rén dàdōu shì xuésheng.
column7: Most of the people who came were students.

column3: The whole world: 全世界的人, 传遍全世界, 在全世界都有名. It is 全 "whole" plus 世界 "world", and works as a noun or before a verb. 界 has 田 "field" for a boundary and 介 for the sound, which is jiè in both.
column4: 这首歌全世界的人都知道。
column5: 這首歌全世界的人都知道。
column6: Zhè shǒu gē quánshìjiè de rén dōu zhīdào.
column7: People all over the world know this song.

column3: Numerous, usually before a noun: 众多游客 "numerous tourists", 众多的原因, 人口众多 "a large population". Written, and used only for countable things such as people or objects. 众 is three people 人, a crowd, and 多 is two evenings 夕, "many".
column4: 这座城市有众多的游客。
column5: 這座城市有眾多的遊客。
column6: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu zhòngduō de yóukè.
column7: This city has numerous tourists.

column3: To add up to, in total: 共计五十人, 共计三千元. Used in reports and notices when numbers are summed, and placed before the figure. 共 shows two hands lifting an object together, and 计 "count" has 讠 for speech.
column4: 今天来的客人共计五十人。
column5: 今天來的客人共計五十人。
column6: Jīntiān lái de kèrén gòngjì wǔshí rén.
column7: Altogether fifty guests came today.

column3: To share by using or enjoying together: 共享单车 "shared bikes", 共享经济, 资源共享, 共享文件. It is for something held in common, while 分享 is to give someone a share of what you have. 享 is a picture of an ancestral shrine, a place for enjoying offerings.
column4: 我们和邻居共享一个花园。
column5: 我們和鄰居共享一個花園。
column6: Wǒmen hé línjū gòngxiǎng yī ge huāyuán.
column7: We share a garden with our neighbors.

column3: Overall, as a whole: 总体来说 "generally speaking", 总体情况, 总体上看. It comes first in a sentence to give a general view before details, or before a noun. 总 shows many mouths 口 with one heart 心, bringing it all together. 体 is the body, 亻 and 本.
column4: 总体来说，今年的成绩不错。
column5: 總體來說，今年的成績不錯。
column6: Zǒngtǐ láishuō, jīnnián de chéngjì bùcuò.
column7: On the whole, this year's results are good.

column3: Only, sole, one and no other: 唯一的机会 "the only chance", 唯一的办法, 唯一一个. It comes before the noun and nearly always takes 的. The same 唯 is in 唯有 "only", both marking one and no more. 唯 has 口 "mouth" and 隹.
column6: Zhè shì wǒ wéiyī de jīhuì.
column7: This is my only chance.

column3: Of just one kind, not varied: 单一品种 "a single variety", 收入来源单一, 结构单一 "uniform in structure". Often a sign of weakness: little variety. It is not the same as 唯一, which is "the only one". It can be an adjective after 很.
column6: Tā de shōurù láiyuán hěn dānyī.
column7: He has only one source of income.

column3: In narration, "all one could see was…", introducing something that suddenly appears or happens: 只见他拿起包就跑了, 只见天上乌云密布. It belongs to storytelling and fiction, and the person who sees is the narrator or the characters. It is followed by a clause.
column4: 只见他拿起包就跑了出去。
column5: 只見他拿起包就跑了出去。
column6: Zhǐjiàn tā ná qǐ bāo jiù pǎo le chūqù.
column7: All I saw was him grabbing his bag and running out.

column3: More than, not limited to: 不止一次 "more than once", 不止我一个人 "not only me", 十个不止. After a verb it also means "without stopping": 笑个不止. 止 is a footprint, a foot, so it means "stop", and 不止 means "does not stop at".
column4: 这本书我看了不止一次。
column5: 這本書我看了不止一次。
column6: Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le bùzhǐ yī cì.
column7: I have read this book more than once.

column3: The total, the whole number of something: 总数为一百, 占总数的百分之十 "make up ten percent of the total", 总数增加. It sits at the end of a count. 总 is many mouths 口 under one heart 心, bringing things together, and 数 is the number, read shù here and shǔ in the verb "to count".
column4: 报名的学生总数超过两千。
column5: 報名的學生總數超過兩千。
column6: Bàomíng de xuésheng zǒngshù chāoguò liǎngqiān.
column7: The total number of students who registered is over two thousand.

column3: Unless, only if: 除非…否则… "unless…, otherwise…" and 除非…才… "only if…, then…". The condition is the only way out: 除非你去，他才会来 "only if you go will he come". It sets one necessary condition, and the clause with 否则 says what happens without it.
column4: 除非你亲自去，否则他不会答应。
column5: 除非你親自去，否則他不會答應。
column6: Chúfēi nǐ qīnzì qù, fǒuzé tā bù huì dāyìng.
column7: Unless you go in person, he will not agree.

column3: Even if: 即使…也… "even if…, still…". It describes something not real or not certain: 即使下雨，我们也去. If the fact is real, use 虽然 or 尽管 instead. 即 shows a person at a bowl of food, "right at" it, and 使 means "cause".
column6: Jíshǐ xiàyǔ, wǒmen yě yào qù.
column7: Even if it rains, we will go.

column3: Although, in spite of: 尽管…但是/可是/还是… "although…, still…". It states a fact and then the result goes against it. It can also mean "feel free to": 你尽管说 "go right ahead and say it". 尽 is read jǐn here and jìn in 尽力. The traditional form 儘 is for jǐn.
column4: 尽管很累，他还是坚持工作。
column5: 儘管很累，他還是堅持工作。
column6: Jǐnguǎn hěn lèi, tā háishi jiānchí gōngzuò.
column7: Although he was tired, he kept on working.

column3: After all, when all is said and done: it gives the reason behind something that might otherwise surprise: 他毕竟是孩子 "he is only a child, after all". It comes before the verb or the predicate. 毕 "finish" and 竟 "end", both about reaching the end.
column6: Tā bìjìng háishi ge háizi.
column7: After all, he is still a child.

column3: Or, in statements: 咖啡或是茶 "coffee or tea", 坐地铁或是打车. It is the same as 或者, a little more spoken. Questions use 还是: 你喝咖啡还是茶？. 或是 offers choices, any of which will do. 是 here is just a link to 或, "or is".
column4: 你可以坐地铁或是打车。
column5: 你可以坐地鐵或是打車。
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò dìtiě huòshì dǎchē.
column7: You can take the subway or a taxi.

column3: Two uses. 1) "A 也好，B 也好" means "whether A or B", for both options: 去也好，不去也好. 2) After a statement it says "that's fine, may as well": 这样也好. The 也 shows that this is one acceptable option among others.
column4: 你来也好，不来也好，都没关系。
column5: 你來也好，不來也好，都沒關係。
column6: Nǐ lái yěhǎo, bù lái yěhǎo, dōu méiguānxi.
column7: Whether you come or not, it does not matter.

column3: Used for contrast with what was expected: 这个办法倒是不错 "this method is actually good (but…)". It softens a "but" or concedes a point before another one. It can also urge someone: 你倒是说话呀 "say something!". 倒 is read dào here (not dǎo) and 是 is neutral.
column4: 这家店不大，东西倒是挺全的。
column5: 這家店不大，東西倒是挺全的。
column6: Zhè jiā diàn bù dà, dōngxi dàoshi tǐng quán de.
column7: The shop is not big, but it has quite a complete range.

column3: Only, nothing more than: 只不过是… "it is merely…", and with 而已 at the end. It plays something down: 我只不过开个玩笑. Often used to defend oneself or to reduce a worry. The 不 is neutral: zhǐbuguò.
column6: Wǒ zhǐbuguò shì kāi ge wánxiào.
column7: I was only joking.

column3: Obviously, plainly, usually followed by something that does not fit: 明明知道，却… "clearly knows, yet…", 明明是你错了. It carries surprise or irritation. 明 is the sun 日 beside the moon 月, so "bright", and doubling it makes the emphasis.
column4: 他明明知道，却不告诉我。
column5: 他明明知道，卻不告訴我。
column6: Tā míngmíng zhīdào, què bù gàosu wǒ.
column7: He clearly knows, yet he will not tell me.

column3: Unexpectedly, surprisingly, with the speaker amazed: 居然忘了 "actually forgot", 居然能… "can even…". It sits before the verb. 竟然 is almost the same. It tells you what the speaker thought would not happen, often bad news.
column4: 他居然忘了自己的生日。
column5: 他居然忘了自己的生日。
column6: Tā jūrán wàng le zìjǐ de shēngrì.
column7: He actually forgot his own birthday.

column3: Without doubt: 这无疑是…, 无疑会… "will no doubt". It is often placed before the verb and is formal. It can also be a predicate: 确定无疑 "certain beyond doubt". 无 is the short form of 無 "without" and 疑 is "doubt".
column6: Zhè wúyí shì yī ge hǎo xiāoxi.
column7: This is undoubtedly good news.

column3: At long last, finally, after trouble or waiting: 总算来了, 总算完成了. The thing wanted has happened. It can also mean "on the whole it can be counted as": 总算不错. 算 has a bamboo ⺮ abacus, "count", so it says "it can finally be counted as done".
column4: 等了一个小时，车总算来了。
column5: 等了一個小時，車總算來了。
column6: Děng le yī ge xiǎoshí, chē zǒngsuàn lái le.
column7: After waiting an hour, the bus finally came.

column3: Three uses. As an adverb it means "surely": 他肯定会来. As an adjective it is "definite": 肯定的答案 "a definite answer". As a verb it is "to affirm, recognize": 肯定他的成绩. 肯 "be willing" and 定 "settle": a matter settled.
column6: Tā kěndìng huì lái de.
column7: He will certainly come.

column3: Never, on no account: 决不放弃 "never give up", 决不允许. A strong promise or refusal about what one will do or allow, before the verb. 绝不 is the same. 决 has two dots 冫 on the left (not three, 氵) and 夬 on the right.
column6: Wǒ juébù huì fàngqì.
column7: I will never give up.

column3: To estimate, to reckon: 估计一下 "make an estimate", 估计会下雨, 我估计… "I guess…". Spoken, and covers a rough number as well as a guess. 估 sounds nearly like its part 古 (gǔ). Compare 评估, a formal assessment.
column4: 我估计他今天不会来了。
column5: 我估計他今天不會來了。
column6: Wǒ gūjì tā jīntiān bù huì lái le.
column7: I reckon he will not come today.

column3: To associate one thing with another, or to be reminded: 联想到… "be reminded of…", 由…联想到…, 自由联想 "free association". The thing that triggers it comes first, the thing recalled after 到. 联 "link" and 想 "think".
column4: 看到这张照片，我联想到小时候。
column5: 看到這張照片，我聯想到小時候。
column6: Kàndào zhè zhāng zhàopiàn, wǒ liánxiǎng dào xiǎoshíhou.
column7: Seeing this photo reminds me of my childhood.

column3: To imagine, to picture in advance: 设想一下 "imagine", 设想未来. As a noun it is a plan or idea. It also means "to consider for someone": 为别人设想. It is more careful and planned than 想象, a freer imagining. 设 has 讠 "speech", as in 设计.
column4: 请你设想一下十年后的生活。
column5: 請你設想一下十年後的生活。
column6: Qǐng nǐ shèxiǎng yīxià shí nián hòu de shēnghuó.
column7: Please imagine life ten years from now.

column3: Thinking, mode of thought: 思维方式 "way of thinking", 逻辑思维 "logical thinking", 创新思维. It is a noun for how the mind works, never a verb. 思 is a heart 心 under a field-like top and 维 has 纟 "thread", a thread of thought.
column6: Tā de sīwéi fāngshì hěn tèbié.
column7: His way of thinking is very special.

column3: Awareness, consciousness; and as a verb, to realize: 意识到问题 "realize there is a problem", 没有意识到, 环保意识 "environmental awareness". When it is a verb it needs 到 after it. 意 "idea" has 心 "heart" and 音 "sound".
column4: 他还没有意识到问题的严重性。
column5: 他還沒有意識到問題的嚴重性。
column6: Tā hái méiyǒu yìshí dào wèntí de yánzhòngxìng.
column7: He still has not realized how serious the problem is.

column3: Will, willpower: 意志力, 坚强的意志 "a strong will", 意志坚定. A person's determination to hold to a goal in difficulty. 志 is a scholar's 士 mind 心, a set purpose, and 士 also helps the sound.
column6: Tā yǒu hěn qiáng de yìzhì.
column7: He has a very strong will.

column3: A firm belief or conviction: 坚定的信念, 失去信念, 坚持自己的信念. Deeper than 想法 "idea", it is what a person is sure of and acts on. 信 is a person 亻 whose words 言 are trusted, and 念 keeps the present 今 in the heart 心.
column4: 他始终坚持自己的信念。
column5: 他始終堅持自己的信念。
column6: Tā shǐzhōng jiānchí zìjǐ de xìnniàn.
column7: He has always held to his own beliefs.

column3: To regard as: 把A看成B "treat A as B", 看成是…; and to misread, to see as by mistake: 把"己"看成了"已". Takes an object after 把. 看 is a hand shielding the eyes 目, and 成 means "become".
column6: Bùyào bǎ péngyou kànchéng dírén.
column7: Do not regard your friends as enemies.

column3: To make out, to see through to a fact: 看出来, 看得出 "can tell", 看不出 "cannot tell". The thing seen is a hidden fact or feeling, not just seen with the eyes: 我看出他不高兴. 出 is a result complement meaning "out" into view.
column4: 我看出他有点儿不高兴。
column5: 我看出他有點兒不高興。
column6: Wǒ kànchū tā yǒudiǎnr bù gāoxìng.
column7: I can see he is a bit unhappy.

column3: To regard or treat, with an attitude: 看待问题 "view a problem", 正确看待, 如何看待… "how do you see…". The object is an abstract matter or a person's status: 把他当朋友看待. 待 is read dài here, "treat", and has 彳 "step" with 寺.
column4: 我们应该正确看待失败。
column5: 我們應該正確看待失敗。
column6: Wǒmen yīnggāi zhèngquè kàndài shībài.
column7: We should look at failure in the right way.

column3: To regard as, in formal writing: 被视为 "is regarded as", 视…为… "see… as…", 视为理所当然 "take for granted". A written alternative to 看成 and 当作. 视 has 见 "see", and 为 here is read wéi.
column4: 这种做法被视为不礼貌。
column5: 這種做法被視為不禮貌。
column6: Zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ bèi shìwéi bù lǐmào.
column7: This way of doing it is regarded as impolite.

column3: To recognize or know by sight: 认字 "know characters", 认路 "know the way", 认出来 "recognize someone"; also to admit, as in 认错 "admit a mistake", and in 认识, 认为, 认真. In 认, the right part 人 replaced the older 忍 and sounds like rén.
column4: 他一下子就把我认出来了。
column5: 他一下子就把我認出來了。
column6: Tā yīxiàzi jiù bǎ wǒ rèn chūlái le.
column7: He recognized me right away.

column3: To be convinced, to hold firmly: 认定他是对的 "firmly believe he is right", 一口认定. It can sound stubborn, a judgment made once and not changed. In official use it means to determine: 认定事实, 被认定为. 定 shows a person settling 疋 under a roof 宀.
column6: Tā rèndìng zhè jiàn shì shì duì de.
column7: He is convinced that this is right.

column3: Subjective: 主观想法 "subjective idea", 太主观, 主观愿望 "wishful thinking". The opposite is 客观. Used in speech too, and often as a mild criticism: "you see it only from your own side". 观 is 又 plus 见, "see again", and 主 is the master, the self.
column6: Zhè zhǐshì nǐ de zhǔguān xiǎngfǎ.
column7: This is only your own subjective idea.

column3: One's way of seeing or judging: 有眼光 "have good judgment", 眼光独到, 用…的眼光看. Used for taste and foresight in choosing: investments, goods, people. Literally also a look, a gaze. 光 is fire above a person, as in a torch held up, and 眼 is the eye.
column6: Tā mǎi dōngxi hěn yǒu yǎnguāng.
column7: She has a good eye for buying things.

column3: To look, in colloquial speech: 瞧一瞧, 瞧瞧, and 你瞧 "look!" to draw attention. In 瞧不起 it means "to look down on". Also "to see" a doctor in the north: 瞧病. 目 "eye" is the meaning part, and 焦 (jiāo) still hints at the sound.
column6: Nǐ qiáo, nàbiān yǒu yī zhī xiǎoniǎo.
column7: Look, there is a little bird over there.

column3: To gaze steadily at something: 注视着前方 "gaze ahead", 目光注视. It is written and slightly literary, for a long, focused look, not a glance. 注 means to pour, with 氵 "water": attention poured onto one object. 视 has 见 "see".
column6: Tā jìngjìng de zhùshì zhe chuāngwài.
column7: He quietly gazed out of the window.

column3: To attach importance to: 注重质量 "emphasize quality", 注重细节 "care about details", 注重培养. The object is an abstract matter or a quality, and the subject a person or organization. 注 "pour attention" and 重 "heavy, weighty".
column4: 这家公司很注重产品质量。
column5: 這家公司很注重產品質量。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī hěn zhùzhòng chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
column7: This company pays great attention to product quality.

column3: To look something up or inquire: 查询成绩 "check results", 网上查询, 查询电话 "inquiry line". You consult a source such as a database, website or office. 查 "check" and 询 "ask", which has 讠 "speech".
column4: 你可以在网上查询成绩。
column5: 你可以在網上查詢成績。
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ zài wǎngshàng cháxún chéngjì.
column7: You can check the results online.

column3: To inspect and test whether something meets a standard: 质量检验, 检验合格 "passed inspection", 实践是检验真理的标准. The object is a product, a result or an idea. 检 and 验 share 佥 on the right, which gives both the sound (jiǎn, yàn).
column4: 产品出厂前要经过检验。
column5: 產品出廠前要經過檢驗。
column6: Chǎnpǐn chūchǎng qián yào jīngguò jiǎnyàn.
column7: Products have to be inspected before leaving the factory.

column3: To notice or realize, often late: 发觉自己错了, 才发觉… "only then noticed…". The thing was already there and you now see it. A clause usually follows. 觉 is read jué here, "sense", but jiào in 睡觉 "sleep".
column4: 回到家，我才发觉钥匙不见了。
column5: 回到家，我才發覺鑰匙不見了。
column6: Huídào jiā, wǒ cái fājué yàoshi bù jiàn le.
column7: Only when I got home did I notice that the key was gone.

column3: A clue, a trail to follow: 找到线索, 提供线索 "give a lead", 案件的线索. The clue is a thread leading to a solution. 线 has 纟 "thread" and 索 is a rope, so "thread and rope". It is also the line of a story: 故事线索.
column6: Jǐngchá zhǎodào le xīn de xiànsuǒ.
column7: The police found a new clue.

column3: The truth of a matter, what really happened: 了解真相, 事实真相, 真相大白 "the truth comes out". It is about facts, usually hidden. Not for "true" in general. 相 here is read xiàng, "appearance" (in 相 for "each other", xiāng), and 真 is "real".
column4: 记者终于查出了事情的真相。
column5: 記者終於查出了事情的真相。
column6: Jìzhě zhōngyú chá chū le shìqing de zhēnxiàng.
column7: The reporter finally found out the truth of the matter.

column3: To confirm or verify that something is true: 证实消息, 得到证实 "be confirmed", 未经证实 "unconfirmed". The subject is evidence or an authority, and the object a claim. 证 "prove" and 实 "real, solid".
column4: 这个消息已经被证实了。
column5: 這個消息已經被證實了。
column6: Zhège xiāoxi yǐjīng bèi zhèngshí le.
column7: This news has been confirmed.

column3: Truth in the sense of a sound principle: 追求真理 "seek truth", 科学真理, 真理只有一个. It is an abstract word for what is always right, not for a fact. For "true or false" use 真假. 真 "true" and 理 "principle".
column4: 科学家一生都在追求真理。
column5: 科學家一生都在追求真理。
column6: Kēxuéjiā yīshēng dōu zài zhuīqiú zhēnlǐ.
column7: Scientists spend their whole lives seeking truth.

column3: A formula: 数学公式, 套公式 "apply a formula", 化学公式. It can be a fixed way of doing something: 办事不能套公式. 式 shows a craftsman with an awl and measuring square, so "model, form". 公 "common" and 式 "form": a form anyone may use.
column6: Zhège gōngshì hěn nán jì.
column7: This formula is hard to remember.

column3: The principle behind how something works: 基本原理, 工作原理 "working principle", 科学原理. It answers "why does this work?". 原 shows a spring flowing out of a cliff, a source, and 理 is "reason", so it is the reasoning at the source.
column4: 老师给我们讲了这台机器的原理。
column5: 老師給我們講了這臺機器的原理。
column6: Lǎoshī gěi wǒmen jiǎng le zhè tái jīqì de yuánlǐ.
column7: The teacher explained to us the principle of this machine.

column3: Logic: 逻辑思维, 有逻辑 "logical", 逻辑清楚. It was formed as a sound-loan from English "logic". In speech 没有逻辑 says that what someone said does not hang together. In the stored reading the 辑 is neutral: luóji.
column6: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒu luóji.
column7: What he says is very logical.

column3: To assess the work or ability of people against a standard: 考核员工, 年终考核 "year-end review", 通过考核. It is an organized, regular evaluation, in companies and schools, with results. 考 "test" and 核 "check closely".
column4: 公司每年都要考核员工。
column5: 公司每年都要考核員工。
column6: Gōngsī měi nián dōu yào kǎohé yuángōng.
column7: The company assesses its employees every year.

column3: A target or indicator: 经济指标 "economic indicators", 完成指标 "meet the target", 质量指标. It is a number to reach or to watch, often set from above. 指 "point to" and 标 "mark": the mark to be pointed at.
column4: 今年的生产指标已经完成了。
column5: 今年的生產指標已經完成了。
column6: Jīnnián de shēngchǎn zhǐbiāo yǐjīng wánchéng le.
column7: This year's production target has been met.

column3: To collect, to gather things together: 收集资料 "gather material", 收集邮票 "collect stamps", 收集意见. It can be a hobby or a task. 收 "take in" and 集, which shows birds 隹 gathering on a tree 木, so both characters mean to bring together.
column6: Tā xǐhuan shōují jiù yìngbì.
column7: He likes to collect old coins.

column3: All around, the surroundings: 四周都是山, 房子四周, 看看四周. It works as a place word, after a noun or alone. 周围 is almost the same. 周 means "around", with a border 冂.
column6: Fángzi sìzhōu dōu shì shù.
column7: The house is surrounded by trees.

column3: The outside world, what is outside a group or a person: 与外界联系 "contact with the outside", 外界的影响, 外界环境. It is set against the inside: a family, a company, a body. 界 has 田 "field" and a boundary, and 介 sounds exactly alike, jiè.
column6: Tā hěn shǎo hé wàijiè liánxì.
column7: He rarely has contact with the outside world.

column3: The depths, a deep inner part: 内心深处 "deep in one's heart", 森林深处, 海洋深处. It follows the place or heart that is deep: X 的深处. Here 处 is read chù, "place", not chǔ "deal with".
column6: Tā zǒujìn le sēnlín de shēnchù.
column7: He walked into the depths of the forest.

column3: A place far away: 远处传来… "from afar comes…", 在远处, 从远处看. The opposite is 近处. It is a place word, so it can be a subject or follow 在 and 从. 远 has 辶 "walk" and 元, whose sound (yuán) is close to yuǎn.
column4: 远处传来了一阵音乐声。
column5: 遠處傳來了一陣音樂聲。
column6: Yuǎnchù chuánlái le yī zhèn yīnyuè shēng.
column7: A burst of music came from far away.

column3: In front of, near someone, spoken and northern: 到他跟前, 在我跟前, 孩子跟前 "beside the child". Also "just before" a date: 年跟前 "just before New Year". It is used for the closeness of a person, not of a thing. 跟 has 足 "foot", as in being at someone's heels.
column4: 孩子跑到妈妈跟前，抱住了她。
column5: 孩子跑到媽媽跟前，抱住了她。
column6: Háizi pǎo dào māma gēnqián, bàozhù le tā.
column7: The child ran up to its mother and hugged her.

column3: To be close to, to approach: 靠近窗户 "near the window", 不要靠近 "do not come near", 靠近我. It takes the object directly. 靠 means to lean against, and 近 has 斤, whose sound (jīn) is near jìn.
column6: Qǐng bùyào kàojìn zhè tiáo hé.
column7: Please do not go near this river.

column3: The region around a place: 北京一带, 长江一带, 这一带 "around here". After a place name it makes a vague area, without strict borders. 带 shows a belt, so the area is a belt around the place.
column6: Zhè yīdài de jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
column7: Transport around here is very convenient.

column3: Forward, onward: 向前走, 向前看 "look ahead", 向前迈进 "move forward". It describes direction and also progress, often in a slogan: 勇敢向前. 向 is "toward", 前 "front".
column6: Qǐng xiàngqián zǒu wǔshí mǐ.
column7: Please walk forward fifty meters.

column3: Upward: 向上看, 向上爬 "climb up". It also describes striving for self-improvement: 积极向上 "positive and aspiring", 天天向上. 上 is a short stroke above a long one, the picture of "above", and 下 is the reverse.
column6: Tā táitóu xiàngshàng kàn.
column7: He raised his head and looked up.

column3: Up and down. After a number it is "about": 三十岁上下 "around thirty", 一百斤上下. It can mean "all over": 全身上下. In 上下文 it is "context". 左右 is used the same way after a number.
column4: 他三十岁上下，戴着眼镜。
column5: 他三十歲上下，戴著眼鏡。
column6: Tā sānshí suì shàngxià, dàizhe yǎnjìng.
column7: He is about thirty and wears glasses.

column3: The place where something is: 所在地 "location", 问题的所在 "where the problem lies", 他所在的公司 "the company he is in". It is a formal noun, after 的 or a verb. 所 shows an axe 斤 at a door 户, and 在 is "be at".
column6: Zhè jiù shì wèntí de suǒzài.
column7: This is where the problem lies.

column3: Inner, intrinsic: 内在美 "inner beauty", 内在联系 "inner connection", 内在动力. It is the opposite of 外在, and used for qualities that are part of the thing itself. 内 is a person entering 冂 a house or frame.
column4: 内在的美比外表更重要。
column5: 內在的美比外表更重要。
column6: Nèizài de měi bǐ wàibiǎo gèng zhòngyào.
column7: Inner beauty matters more than looks.

column3: Within, inside a limit of time, space or range: 三天之内 "within three days", 一公里之内, 预料之内 "within expectations". It is more formal than 以内 and follows the thing it measures. 之 is a classical "of" in set phrases.
column6: Qǐng zài sān tiān zhīnèi huífù wǒ.
column7: Please reply to me within three days.

column3: Outside, besides: 除了…之外 "apart from…", 意料之外 "unexpected", 国门之外 "beyond the borders". In 除了…之外 it is followed by 还 for "as well as" or by 都 for "all except". 外 shows a night-time divination, "outside" the usual.
column4: 除了数学之外，他还喜欢历史。
column5: 除了數學之外，他還喜歡歷史。
column6: Chúle shùxué zhīwài, tā hái xǐhuan lìshǐ.
column7: Besides math, he also likes history.

column3: Under, below, also in a condition: 在…之下, 在大家的帮助之下 "with everyone's help", 在领导之下 "under the leadership of", 零度之下. With abstract things it gives the circumstances in which something happens. Written, more formal than 下面.
column4: 在大家的帮助之下，他完成了任务。
column5: 在大家的幫助之下，他完成了任務。
column6: Zài dàjiā de bāngzhù zhīxià, tā wánchéng le rènwu.
column7: With everyone's help, he completed the task.

column3: In the midst of, among: 在…之中, 困难之中 "amid difficulties", 人群之中 "in the crowd", 忙碌之中. It places someone within a situation or group. More literary than 里. 中 is a line through the middle of a box, as in a flagpole through the center.
column4: 他在危险之中保持冷静。
column5: 他在危險之中保持冷靜。
column6: Tā zài wēixiǎn zhīzhōng bǎochí lěngjìng.
column7: He stayed calm in the midst of danger.

column3: Included: 包括…在内 "including…", 连我在内 "myself included", 费用在内. It comes after the things counted, to show they are part of the total. Other times it can be "inside": 在内部. It needs something named before it.
column4: 连我在内，一共有五个人。
column5: 連我在內，一共有五個人。
column6: Lián wǒ zàinèi, yīgòng yǒu wǔ ge rén.
column7: Counting me, there are five people altogether.

column3: To be present at the scene: 在场的人 "those present", 当时在场, 不在场证明 "alibi". It is a verb, with no object. 场 here is read chǎng, "a place where something happens". 场 has 土 "earth" for the meaning.
column4: 事故发生时，他正好在场。
column5: 事故發生時，他正好在場。
column6: Shìgù fāshēng shí, tā zhènghǎo zàichǎng.
column7: He happened to be present when the accident occurred.

column3: Lower than, below: 低于平均水平 "below average", 低于零度 "below zero". A formal comparison in numbers, set against 高于. It follows the thing compared, with the standard after it. 于 is the simplified form of 於, and means "than" here.
column6: Jīntiān de wēndù dīyú língdù.
column7: Today's temperature is below zero.

column3: Higher than, above a standard: 高于平均水平 "above average", 高于零度, 高于 + number. A formal comparison in written Chinese, the pair of 低于. Speech uses 比…高. 高 is a drawing of a tall building.
column4: 这里的房价高于全国平均水平。
column5: 這裡的房價高於全國平均水平。
column6: Zhèlǐ de fángjià gāoyú quánguó píngjūn shuǐpíng.
column7: House prices here are above the national average.

column3: Greater than, more than: 五大于三 "5 is greater than 3", 大于等于 "greater than or equal to". Mostly for numbers, measures and comparisons, as in mathematics, rules and reports. For ordinary sizes speech uses 比…大. 大 is a person standing with arms stretched out.
column6: Wǔ dàyú sān.
column7: Five is greater than three.

column3: To revolve around, or to center on: 地球围绕太阳转, 围绕这个问题讨论 "discuss with this problem as the focus", 围绕…展开. The center can be a real object or a topic. Both characters are about going around: 围 is an enclosure 囗 and 绕 has 纟 "thread", wound round.
column6: Dìqiú wéirào tàiyáng zhuàn.
column7: The earth goes around the sun.

column3: Detailed, in detail: 详细的介绍, 详细说明 "explain in detail", 说得很详细. It can be an adjective or an adverb before a verb, with or without 地. The opposite is 简单. 详 has 讠 "speech" and 羊, whose sound yáng is close to xiáng.
column6: Qǐng nǐ xiángxì de shuō yīxià.
column7: Please tell me in detail.

column3: Careful and attentive, about paying close attention to details: 仔细看 "look carefully", 仔细检查, 仔细想想. It is for attention, while 小心 is for care against danger. Here 仔 is read zǐ, not zǎi as in "young animal".
column6: Nǐ yào zǐxì jiǎnchá yī biàn.
column7: You must check it carefully once.

column3: Straightforward and decisive; as an adverb, "simply, might as well": 太麻烦了，干脆不去了; 他说话很干脆. It proposes the clean way out, cutting the matter short. 干 is read gān here and is the simplified form of several old characters, including 乾 "dry". 脆 is "crisp", so it is a "dry, crisp" snap.
column6: Tài máfan le, gāncuì bié qù le.
column7: It is too much trouble, so let's just not go.

column3: As one pleases, freely: 请随意 "please make yourself at home", 随意选择 "choose freely", 随意坐. Polite when offering a free choice to a guest. Used about a bad habit it means "carelessly": 随意乱扔. 随 "follow" and 意 "wish", so "following one's wish".
column6: Dàjiā suíyì zuò, bùyòng kèqi.
column7: Sit wherever you like, no need to stand on ceremony.

column3: Negative, passive in attitude: 消极的态度 "negative attitude", 消极情绪, 消极等待 "wait passively". The opposite is 积极. It describes a mind or behavior, not a result. The sound part of 极, 及, is read jí too, just the same.
column4: 不要用消极的态度面对问题。
column5: 不要用消極的態度面對問題。
column6: Bùyào yòng xiāojí de tàidù miànduì wèntí.
column7: Do not face problems with a negative attitude.

column3: Passive, on the receiving end: 处于被动 "be in a weak position", 很被动 "at a disadvantage", 被动语态 "the passive voice". The opposite is 主动. It is about who has the initiative. 被 is the passive marker, and 动 here means to act.
column4: 他在比赛中一直很被动。
column5: 他在比賽中一直很被動。
column6: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng yīzhí hěn bèidòng.
column7: He was on the defensive throughout the match.

column3: Hard, full of hardship: 艰难的生活, 艰难地前进, 处境艰难. It describes a hard life, journey or situation that takes effort to bear, a more serious word than 难. In 艰 and 难 the left parts were replaced in simplification by 又, which they share.
column4: 他们度过了一段艰难的日子。
column5: 他們度過了一段艱難的日子。
column6: Tāmen dùguò le yī duàn jiānnán de rìzi.
column7: They went through a difficult time.

column3: Indirect: 间接地 + verb, 间接影响 "indirect effect", 间接经验 "second-hand experience". The opposite is 直接. 间 is read jiàn here ("gap, in between"), not jiān as in 时间. 间 shows the sun 日 shining through a doorway 门, a gap.
column6: Wǒ shì jiànjiē tīngshuō de.
column7: I only heard it indirectly.

column3: Quietly, without noise: 悄悄地走, 悄悄地说. The point is making no sound, as not to disturb: a child leaving a sleeping parent's room. 偷偷 is about not letting people know. 悄 has 忄 "heart" and 肖, which still sounds near, xiāo and qiāo.
column6: Tā qiāoqiāo de zǒuchū le fángjiān.
column7: She quietly left the room.

column3: Secretly, on the sly, doing something you should not or do not want known: 偷偷地 + verb, 偷偷看, 偷偷笑. 悄悄 is about being quiet, while 偷偷 is about hiding it. Alone, 偷 means to steal, and 亻 "person" is the meaning part.
column4: 他偷偷地吃了一块蛋糕。
column5: 他偷偷地吃了一塊蛋糕。
column6: Tā tōutōu de chī le yī kuài dàngāo.
column7: He secretly ate a piece of cake.

column3: Tightly, firmly: 紧紧地抱着, 紧紧握住, 紧紧跟着 "follow closely". It always goes before a verb, with or without 地. 紧 has 糸 "silk" at the bottom: something tied, drawn tight.
column6: Háizi jǐnjǐn de bàozhe māma.
column7: The child hugged its mother tightly.

column3: An act or movement of a person, seen by others: 一举一动 "every move", 可疑的举动 "suspicious behavior", 奇怪的举动. It is a noun for what someone does, often considered surprising. 举 "raise" and 动 "move".
column4: 他的举动让大家很吃惊。
column5: 他的舉動讓大家很吃驚。
column6: Tā de jǔdòng ràng dàjiā hěn chījīng.
column7: His behavior surprised everyone.

column3: Soft: 软床, 柔软 "gentle, soft", 软面包. Also gentle or weak in a person: 心软 "soft-hearted", 腿软 "weak in the legs". The opposite is 硬. This is the 软 of 软件. The 车 on the left is the radical for "cart"; 欠 on the right does not give the sound now.
column4: 这张床太软了，我睡不好。
column5: 這張床太軟了，我睡不好。
column6: Zhè zhāng chuáng tài ruǎn le, wǒ shuì bù hǎo.
column7: This bed is too soft, I cannot sleep well.

column3: Hard, stiff: 硬床, 硬币 "coin", 硬座 "hard seat" on a train. As an adverb it means "stubbornly, by force": 他硬要去 "he insisted on going". 石 "stone" is the meaning part, and 更 gives the sound, close to yìng.
column6: Zhège miànbāo tài yìng le.
column7: This bread is too hard.

column3: Flat and smooth, of land or a road: 平坦的道路, 地势平坦 "flat terrain", 平坦的草地. It is for large surfaces, not for a table, which is 平. 坦 has 土 "earth" and 旦, which sounds a bit like tǎn.
column6: Zhè tiáo lù yòu kuān yòu píngtǎn.
column7: This road is wide and level.

column3: Slanted, oblique: 斜线 "slash", 斜坡 "slope", 斜着看 "look sideways", 歪歪斜斜 "crooked". As an adjective it follows the thing or the adverb: 有点儿斜. 斗 on the right is a measuring scoop, which tilts.
column6: Zhè kē shù yǒudiǎnr xié.
column7: This tree leans a little.

column3: Weak, thin in strength: 薄弱环节 "weak link", 基础薄弱 "weak foundation", 意志薄弱 "weak-willed". It is about an abstract thing such as a base, a defense or will, never a weak body. 薄 is read bó here and báo in "thin paper".
column4: 他的英语基础比较薄弱。
column5: 他的英語基礎比較薄弱。
column6: Tā de Yīngyǔ jīchǔ bǐjiào bóruò.
column7: His English foundation is rather weak.

column3: Ancient, age-old: 古老的城市, 古老的传说, 古老的文化. It is used about things with a very long history, not about people. 古 is words passed through ten 十 mouths 口, so old. 老 is a bent person with a cane.
column6: Zhè shì yī zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì.
column7: This is an ancient city.

column3: Very long, seeming endless: 漫长的冬天, 漫长的等待 "a long wait", 漫长的历史. Time or a journey, with a sense of weariness or sweep. Here 长 is cháng. 漫 has 氵 "water", like water spreading out without limit.
column6: Dōngtiān zài zhèlǐ hěn màncháng.
column7: Winter is very long here.

column3: Wide, broad, vast: 知识面很广 "a wide range of knowledge", 范围广, 广大. In speech it mostly lives in compounds such as 广泛, 广告, 广场. 广 is also the simplified form of 廣, and as a radical it is a lean-to, a building, in 店 and 度.
column6: Tā de zhīshimiàn hěn guǎng.
column7: He has very wide knowledge.

column3: Widespread, extensive: 广泛使用, 广泛应用, 广泛的兴趣 "wide interests". It describes range, use or influence, and works as an adjective or an adverb before a verb. 泛 has 氵 "water" and 乏, and means to spread out like a flood.
column6: Shǒujī yǐjīng bèi guǎngfàn shǐyòng.
column7: Mobile phones are now widely used.

column3: Vague, blurred: 模糊不清, 记忆模糊 "hazy memory", 视线模糊 "blurred vision", 模糊的概念. As a verb, "to blur": 模糊了界限. Here 模 is mó (not mú as in 模样) and 糊 is neutral. 糊 has 米 "rice", for paste, which smears.
column4: 我对那件事的记忆很模糊。
column5: 我對那件事的記憶很模糊。
column6: Wǒ duì nà jiàn shì de jìyì hěn móhu.
column7: My memory of that matter is hazy.

column3: Tall and large: 高大的树, 高大的楼房, 身材高大. For a person it means tall and strongly built; for buildings and trees, towering. It combines 高 "tall" and 大 "big". It can also be figurative: 高大的形象 "a lofty image".
column4: 他身材高大，像个运动员。
column5: 他身材高大，像個運動員。
column6: Tā shēncái gāodà, xiàng ge yùndòngyuán.
column7: He is tall and strong, like an athlete.

column3: Majestic, grand: 雄伟的建筑, 雄伟的山, 长城雄伟. Used for huge and impressive buildings and landscapes, in written style. 雄 means male and mighty (the 隹 "bird" shows it began with male birds), and 伟 means great, as in 伟大.
column6: Chángchéng kànshàngqù fēicháng xióngwěi.
column7: The Great Wall looks magnificent.

column3: Stinking, smelly: 臭味 "stink", 臭豆腐, 很臭. It also means "bad, disgusting" in speech: 臭脾气 "foul temper", 臭名声 "bad name". 臭 puts the nose 自 over a dog 犬, a dog's strong sense of smell.
column6: Zhè shuāng wàzi tài chòu le.
column7: These socks stink.

column3: Length: 测量长度, 长度为五米, 长度有三百公里. 度 on the end of a word makes a measurable quality: 长度, 高度, 宽度, 深度. It follows the thing measured with 的: 河的长度. 长 is read cháng here, "long".
column4: 这条河的长度有三百公里。
column5: 這條河的長度有三百公里。
column6: Zhè tiáo hé de chángdù yǒu sānbǎi gōnglǐ.
column7: This river is three hundred kilometers long.

column3: Height, and as an adverb "highly": 飞机的高度, 海拔高度 "altitude", 高度重视 "attach great importance", 高度紧张. With abstract words it is a formal intensifier. 度 makes a measurable quality of 高, as in 长度, 宽度 and 深度.
column4: 飞机飞到了一万米的高度。
column5: 飛機飛到了一萬米的高度。
column6: Fēijī fēi dào le yīwàn mǐ de gāodù.
column7: The plane flew to a height of ten thousand meters.

column3: Width: 路的宽度, 宽度为三米. Like 长度, it is the measurable quality of 宽 "wide". 宽 has 宀 "roof", for the breadth of a room, and in simplification its right-hand part changed from 萈 to 苋.
column4: 这条路的宽度只有两米。
column5: 這條路的寬度只有兩米。
column6: Zhè tiáo lù de kuāndù zhǐyǒu liǎng mǐ.
column7: This road is only two meters wide.

column3: Depth: 水的深度, 深度超过一百米, and figuratively 文章缺乏深度 "the article lacks depth". As an adjective before a noun, "in depth": 深度学习 "deep learning", 深度报道. 深 has 氵 "water" with 罙, "deep".
column4: 这个湖的深度超过一百米。
column5: 這個湖的深度超過一百米。
column6: Zhège hú de shēndù chāoguò yībǎi mǐ.
column7: This lake is over a hundred meters deep.

column3: Strength or intensity as a measurable quantity: 运动强度 "exercise intensity", 工作强度大 "heavy workload", 光线强度, 材料的强度. 强 is read qiáng here, not qiǎng as in 勉强. 度 makes a measure of the quality 强, like 长度 and 宽度.
column6: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò de qiángdù hěn dà.
column7: This work is very intensive.

column3: The number of countable things: 数目很大, 数目不对 "the count is off", 参加人员的数目. It is the quantity itself, while 数字 is a written figure. 数 is read shù (noun) and shǔ (verb "to count", 数一遍). 目 is a drawing of an eye turned on its side.
column4: 这个数目不太对，请再数一遍。
column5: 這個數目不太對，請再數一遍。
column6: Zhège shùmù bù tài duì, qǐng zài shǔ yī biàn.
column7: This number is not quite right, please count again.

column3: The range or extent of a change: 涨价幅度 "extent of the price rise", 幅度大 "large", 大幅度 "by a wide margin". It measures how much something rises, falls or swings. 幅 is the width of a roll 畐 of cloth 巾, a span, and 度 makes a measure.
column4: 今年房价上涨的幅度不大。
column5: 今年房價上漲的幅度不大。
column6: Jīnnián fángjià shàngzhǎng de fúdù bù dà.
column7: House prices have not risen by much this year.

column3: The share or proportion of one part within a whole: 占…比重 "take up a share of", 所占比重, 比重较大. In physics, specific gravity. 比 shows two spoons side by side, comparison, and 重 is weight: how heavily something weighs among the rest.
column4: 蔬菜在饮食中的比重应该增加。
column5: 蔬菜在飲食中的比重應該增加。
column6: Shūcài zài yǐnshí zhōng de bǐzhòng yīnggāi zēngjiā.
column7: Vegetables should make up a larger share of the diet.

column3: A grade or rank: 等级高 "high grade", 质量等级, 划分等级 "divide into grades", 等级制度 "hierarchy". The level in a scale of quality, status or difficulty. 级 has 纟 "silk" for a step in a string of threads and 及, which sounds the same, jí.
column4: 这些水果分成三个等级。
column5: 這些水果分成三個等級。
column6: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ fēnchéng sān ge děngjí.
column7: These fruits are sorted into three grades.

column3: A difference: 差别很大, 没有差别, 年龄的差别. It stresses the amount by which two things differ, a gap. 区别 more often means to tell apart, a distinction. 差 is read chā here, not chà "poor". 别 uses 刂 to draw a boundary: "separate".
column4: 这两种产品的价格差别很大。
column5: 這兩種產品的價格差別很大。
column6: Zhè liǎng zhǒng chǎnpǐn de jiàgé chābié hěn dà.
column7: The prices of these two products differ greatly.

column3: A gap between two things, especially a lack on one side: 缩小差距 "narrow the gap", 差距很大, 存在差距. Used between levels such as income, ability and development, and it says that one side is behind. 距 has 足 "foot" for distance, as in 距离.
column4: 我们和他们之间还有很大的差距。
column5: 我們和他們之間還有很大的差距。
column6: Wǒmen hé tāmen zhījiān hái yǒu hěn dà de chājù.
column7: There is still a big gap between us and them.

column3: A straight line: 画直线, 直线距离 "straight-line distance", 走直线. Used as an adverb with a rise or fall, it means "sharply": 直线上升 "shoot up", 直线下降 "plunge". 直 is "straight" and 线 has 纟 "thread", the straightest line being a stretched thread.
column6: Qǐng yòng chǐzi huà yī tiáo zhíxiàn.
column7: Please draw a straight line with a ruler.

column3: To come into physical contact with something, or to be in contact with people, ideas or a field: 接触新事物 "come into contact with new things", 接触过病人. It is a verb that takes an object directly. 接 "connect, receive" + 触 "touch" make the idea of touching that goes with getting acquainted.
column4: 他每天都接触很多新朋友。
column5: 他每天都接觸很多新朋友。
column6: Tā měi tiān dōu jiēchù hěn duō xīn péngyou.
column7: Every day he comes into contact with many new friends.

column3: To join two things so that they are linked: 连接电脑和打印机 "connect the computer and the printer", 连接两个城市. It is the word used for network, cable and wireless connections, and also for roads and bridges. 连 "link up" and 接 "join" both mean joining, so the word is a doubled verb.
column4: 这座桥连接着两个城市。
column5: 這座橋連接著兩個城市。
column6: Zhè zuò qiáo liánjiē zhe liǎng ge chéngshì.
column7: This bridge links the two cities.

column3: To merge two things into one: 合并公司 "merge companies", 合并两个文件 "merge two files". 合 "together" + 并 "combine". It is the opposite of 分开 and is used for companies, files, schools and branches.
column6: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī juédìng hébìng.
column7: These two companies decided to merge.

column3: To inherit property, a title or a position, and in a wider sense to carry on a tradition: 继承遗产 "inherit an estate", 继承传统. The object is what is passed down, and the person who receives it is the subject. 继 "continue" + 承 "receive, bear".
column6: Tā jìchéng le fùqin de gōngsī.
column7: He inherited his father's company.

column3: To follow someone, either physically or as a leader, more formal than the everyday 跟: 跟随老师学习 "study under a teacher", 跟随队伍. It has a faithful, accompanying feel. Both 跟 "heel, follow" and 随 "go along with" mean following.
column4: 孩子们跟随老师参观博物馆。
column5: 孩子們跟隨老師參觀博物館。
column6: Háizimen gēnsuí lǎoshī cānguān bówùguǎn.
column7: The children followed their teacher on a visit to the museum.

column3: To assist, as a verb, or auxiliary and supporting, as a modifier: 辅助教学 "assist teaching", 辅助工具 "auxiliary tool". The thing helped is the main one and 辅助 plays a secondary role. 助 is "help" and 辅 "support", so the two together are close to a synonym pair.
column4: 这个软件可以辅助你学习汉字。
column5: 這個軟體可以輔助你學習漢字。
column6: Zhège ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ fǔzhù nǐ xuéxí Hànzì.
column7: This software can help you study characters.

column3: To extend or stretch out in space, time or meaning: 铁路向远方延伸 "the railway stretches into the distance", 延伸到…, and figuratively 意思延伸 "a meaning extends". Both characters mean stretching: 延 is "prolong" and 伸 is "stretch out", with 亻 as the person who stretches.
column4: 这条路一直延伸到海边。
column5: 這條路一直延伸到海邊。
column6: Zhè tiáo lù yīzhí yánshēn dào hǎibiān.
column7: This road stretches all the way to the seaside.

column3: To go around something, whether circling it or detouring: 绕圈子 "go in circles", 绕路 "take a roundabout way", 绕过障碍 "get around an obstacle". It also means to wind thread on something. The 纟 on the left is silk thread, which is what is wound; the right part supplies the sound.
column4: 我们绕了一大圈才找到那家店。
column5: 我們繞了一大圈才找到那家店。
column6: Wǒmen rào le yī dà quān cái zhǎodào nà jiā diàn.
column7: We went around in a big circle before we found that shop.

column3: To separate or be apart, often of people or things that belonged together: 母子分离 "mother and child separated", 分离出来 "separate out". Used for partings that are not wanted and for scientific separation. 分 "divide" + 离 "leave".
column6: Zhànzhēng shǐ tāmen chángqī fēnlí.
column7: The war kept them apart for a long time.

column3: To break away from or leave behind something one was part of or tied to: 脱离危险 "be out of danger", 脱离实际 "be out of touch with reality", 脱离组织. The thing left is the object. 脱 "shed" + 离 "leave".
column4: 病人已经脱离了生命危险。
column5: 病人已經脫離了生命危險。
column6: Bìngrén yǐjīng tuōlí le shēngmìng wēixiǎn.
column7: The patient is now out of danger.

column3: To divide something into parts: 分成两组 "split into two groups", 分成三份 "divide into three portions". The result comes after 成, so the number and the measure word go there. 分 is "divide" and 成 "become".
column4: 老师把学生分成了四个小组。
column5: 老師把學生分成了四個小組。
column6: Lǎoshī bǎ xuésheng fēnchéng le sì ge xiǎozǔ.
column7: The teacher divided the students into four groups.

column3: To form a matching set, or as a modifier supporting or complementary: 配套设施 "supporting facilities", 配套服务. It is often used for the things that must come with a main item to make it work. 配 "match" + 套 "set".
column4: 新小区的配套设施很齐全。
column5: 新小區的配套設施很齊全。
column6: Xīn xiǎoqū de pèitào shèshī hěn qíquán.
column7: The new residential area has a full range of supporting facilities.

column3: To build a large physical structure from the ground up: 建造房子 "build a house", 建造大桥, 建造工厂. It is about construction work. 建 "set up" + 造 "make".
column4: 他们正在河边建造一座新桥。
column5: 他們正在河邊建造一座新橋。
column6: Tāmen zhèngzài hé biān jiànzào yī zuò xīn qiáo.
column7: They are building a new bridge by the river.

column3: As a noun it is a building or architecture: 古代建筑 "ancient buildings", 建筑师 "architect", 建筑工人. As a verb it is "to construct", but this is rarer. It is the usual word for the field of architecture and construction. 筑 has 竹 on top, since scaffolding and pounding tools were once made of bamboo.
column4: 这座城市有很多古老的建筑。
column5: 這座城市有很多古老的建築。
column6: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu hěn duō gǔlǎo de jiànzhù.
column7: This city has many old buildings.

column3: To build or construct something such as a road, railway, dam or building, usually public works: 修建铁路 "build a railway", 修建水库. It is a little more formal than 建 and suits large projects. 修 is to repair or build and 建 is to set up.
column4: 政府打算在这里修建一条高速公路。
column5: 政府打算在這裡修建一條高速公路。
column6: Zhèngfǔ dǎsuàn zài zhèlǐ xiūjiàn yī tiáo gāosùgōnglù.
column7: The government plans to build an expressway here.

column3: To make something out of a material: 用木头制成 "made of wood", 制成品 "finished product". The pattern is 用/由 + material + 制成 + product, or product + 由 + material + 制成. 制 "make, manufacture" + 成 "become", the result.
column4: 这张桌子是用竹子制成的。
column5: 這張桌子是用竹子製成的。
column6: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì yòng zhúzi zhìchéng de.
column7: This table is made of bamboo.

column3: To come into being or to produce something as a result of a process, a term that is common in science and computing: 生成新的文件 "generate a new file", 水和二氧化碳生成. 生 is "produce" and 成 "become", so something is born and takes shape.
column4: 这个程序会自动生成报告。
column5: 這個程式會自動生成報告。
column6: Zhège chéngxù huì zìdòng shēngchéng bàogào.
column7: This program generates a report automatically.

column3: To combine parts into one whole, especially in chemistry, sound and images, and also a noun for something synthetic: 合成材料 "synthetic material", 合成图片 "composite picture". 合 "join" + 成 "become". It is the opposite of 分解.
column4: 这种布料是用化学纤维合成的。
column5: 這種布料是用化學纖維合成的。
column6: Zhè zhǒng bùliào shì yòng huàxué xiānwéi héchéng de.
column7: This fabric is synthesized from chemical fibers.

column3: To break something down into parts or into simpler substances: 分解成小部分 "break into small parts", 水被分解, 分解动作 "break an action down". It is used for chemical decomposition and for taking a task apart. 解 is "untie, separate" and carries the sense of taking things apart.
column6: Xìjūn kěyǐ fēnjiě lājī.
column7: Bacteria can break down garbage.

column3: To sort things into categories: 垃圾分类 "garbage sorting", 按颜色分类 "classify by color". It is also a noun for a classification. The verb comes before the thing sorted when it is a modifier, and 把 can bring the thing before the verb: 把书分类. 类 means "kind".
column4: 我们把图书按内容分类。
column5: 我們把圖書按內容分類。
column6: Wǒmen bǎ túshū àn nèiróng fēnlèi.
column7: We sort the books by subject.

column3: To divide up an area, a period or responsibilities according to some standard: 划分地区 "divide into regions", 划分责任. It is more about setting boundaries than cutting. 划 is read hua4 here, but it is hua2 in "row a boat".
column4: 这个国家被划分为二十个省。
column5: 這個國家被劃分為二十個省。
column6: Zhège guójiā bèi huàfēn wéi èrshí ge shěng.
column7: This country is divided into twenty provinces.

column3: To pack goods for sale or shipping, and the packaging itself: 包装纸 "wrapping paper", 精美的包装. Figuratively it is to present someone or something attractively, often a little falsely: 包装明星. 包 "wrap" + 装 "load, dress up".
column4: 这份礼物的包装非常漂亮。
column5: 這份禮物的包裝非常漂亮。
column6: Zhè fèn lǐwù de bāozhuāng fēicháng piàoliang.
column7: The wrapping of this gift is very beautiful.

column3: To repair something damaged until it works or looks as it did before: 修复文物 "restore cultural relics", 修复系统漏洞 "fix a system bug", 修复关系 "mend a relationship". It is a bigger and more careful repair than 修理. 复 means "return, restore".
column4: 工人们正在修复被雨水冲坏的路。
column5: 工人們正在修復被雨水沖壞的路。
column6: Gōngrénmen zhèngzài xiūfù bèi yǔshuǐ chōnghuài de lù.
column7: Workers are repairing the road that the rain washed out.

column3: To decorate a room, a building or an object to make it look nicer, and the decoration itself: 装饰房间 "decorate a room", 装饰品 "ornament". 装 is "dress up" and 饰 "adorn", so the word is about making a place or thing look dressed up.
column6: Tā yòng xiānhuā zhuāngshì le kètīng.
column7: She decorated the living room with fresh flowers.

column3: A change or shift, as a noun, and to change as a verb, usually of things that are expected to stay steady, such as plans, prices, personnel: 人事变动 "personnel changes", 价格变动, 没有变动. 变 "change" + 动 "move". It describes adjustments rather than a full transformation.
column4: 公司最近有一些人事变动。
column5: 公司最近有一些人事變動。
column6: Gōngsī zuìjìn yǒu yīxiē rénshì biàndòng.
column7: The company has had some personnel changes recently.

column3: To update or renew, now used above all for software and information: 更新系统 "update the system", 软件更新, 知识更新 "refresh one's knowledge". Read geng1 here, "change", not gèng "even more". 更 "change" + 新 "new".
column6: Shǒujī xūyào gēngxīn xìtǒng le.
column7: The phone needs a system update.

column3: To replace something, usually a worn or old part, by another of the same kind: 更换轮胎 "change a tire", 更换密码 "change a password", 更换地址. It is for swapping one item for another. Read geng1 here, as in 更新, not gèng. 换 means "exchange".
column4: 你该更换这个旧电池了。
column5: 你該更換這個舊電池了。
column6: Nǐ gāi gēnghuàn zhège jiù diànchí le.
column7: You should replace this old battery.

column3: To turn into something different, often of one kind of thing into another: 转化为能量 "convert into energy", 矛盾转化. The pattern is A 转化为 B or A 转化成 B. It suggests a change of nature, not just form. 转 "turn" + 化 "change".
column4: 这种机器把热能转化为电能。
column5: 這種機器把熱能轉化為電能。
column6: Zhè zhǒng jīqì bǎ rènéng zhuǎnhuà wéi diànnéng.
column7: This machine turns heat energy into electricity.

column3: To switch from one state, form or mode to another: 转换角色 "switch roles", 转换思路 "change one's way of thinking", 转换成 "convert into". It stresses an act of switching and is common with formats and modes. 转 "turn" + 换 "exchange".
column6: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn zhuǎnhuàn chéng PDF géshì.
column7: Please convert the file to PDF format.

column3: To change direction, literally for a vehicle or a person, and figuratively to change one's attitude or approach: 向左转向 "turn left", 转向新能源 "turn to new energy". 转 "turn" + 向 "direction". Here 转 is read zhuan3.
column6: Qìchē tūrán xiàng yòu zhuǎnxiàng.
column7: The car suddenly turned right.

column3: To transfer ownership or a right to someone else, for a price or free: 转让房子 "transfer a house", 转让股份 "transfer shares", and the shop sign 店面转让 "shop for transfer". 转 "turn over" + 让 "let, give up". It is a formal, legal and business word.
column6: Tā bǎ diàn zhuǎnràng gěi le péngyou.
column7: He transferred the shop to a friend.

column3: To transfer someone to another post or to move forces, and to mobilize or stir up: 工作调动 "job transfer", 调动积极性 "get people motivated". Read diao4 here, not tiao2: it is the 调 of "transfer", as in 调查 and 调整. 动 adds the idea of moving.
column4: 公司把他调动到上海分公司。
column5: 公司把他調動到上海分公司。
column6: Gōngsī bǎ tā diàodòng dào Shànghǎi fēngōngsī.
column7: The company transferred him to the Shanghai branch.

column3: To adjust something so that it fits or stays in balance: 调节温度 "adjust the temperature", 调节心情 "regulate one's mood", 调节器 "regulator". It suggests fine control of a degree or level. 调 is read tiao2 here, "adjust, blend", and 节 is "regulate".
column4: 你可以自己调节空调的温度。
column5: 你可以自己調節空調的溫度。
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ zìjǐ tiáojié kōngtiáo de wēndù.
column7: You can adjust the air conditioner's temperature yourself.

column3: To mediate in a dispute and bring the two sides to an agreement: 调解纠纷 "settle a dispute", 调解员 "mediator", 法院调解. It is what a third party does, not the sides themselves. Read the second syllable jie3, as in 解决; the 调 is tiao2 as in 调节.
column4: 社区工作人员帮他们调解了矛盾。
column5: 社區工作人員幫他們調解了矛盾。
column6: Shèqū gōngzuò rényuán bāng tāmen tiáojiě le máodùn.
column7: A community worker helped mediate their quarrel.

column3: To flow or move around, for liquids, air, people and money: 空气流动 "air circulates", 流动人口 "migrant population", 流动资金 "working capital". It can also be an adjective, "mobile": 流动图书馆. 流 "flow" + 动 "move".
column4: 河水在山谷里慢慢流动。
column5: 河水在山谷裡慢慢流動。
column6: Héshuǐ zài shāngǔ lǐ mànmàn liúdòng.
column7: The river flows slowly through the valley.

column3: To circulate freely, of money, goods, information or air: 商品流通 "the circulation of goods", 货币流通, 空气流通 "ventilation". It is about passing through without blockage. 流 "flow" + 通 "go through".
column4: 这种新钞已经开始在市场上流通。
column5: 這種新鈔已經開始在市場上流通。
column6: Zhè zhǒng xīn chāo yǐjīng kāishǐ zài shìchǎng shàng liútōng.
column7: This new banknote has started to circulate in the market.

column3: Developments, a trend, or a state of movement, as against 静态: 最新动态 "the latest developments", 市场动态, 关注动态. Social-media users also call a post a 动态 ("update"). It also means dynamic as an adjective. 动 "move" + 态 "state".
column4: 我们要随时关注市场的动态。
column5: 我們要隨時關注市場的動態。
column6: Wǒmen yào suíshí guānzhù shìchǎng de dòngtài.
column7: We must keep following developments in the market at all times.

column3: To increase or add: it is mostly found in compounds, such as 增加, 增长, 增强, 增多, and in the phrase 增产 "increase output". On its own it is a written, bound form. Learn it as the first character of 增加 and the other 增- words, all meaning that something becomes more.
column4: 他的体重一个月增了三公斤。
column5: 他的體重一個月增了三公斤。
column6: Tā de tǐzhòng yī ge yuè zēng le sān gōngjīn.
column7: His weight went up three kilograms in a month.

column3: To increase output, usually of crops, factories or oil: 粮食增产 "grain output rises", 增产增收 "more output and more income". The opposite is 减产. 增 "increase" + 产 "produce".
column6: Jīnnián xiǎomài dàfú zēngchǎn.
column7: Wheat output has risen sharply this year.

column3: To become bigger or to make something bigger in size, force or degree: 压力增大 "pressure grows", 增大面积 "enlarge the area". It suits measurable things such as pressure, risk, distance and area, and the result needs no 了 if it is general. 增 "increase" + 大 "big".
column6: Zhèyàng zuò huì zēngdà fēngxiǎn.
column7: Doing it this way will increase the risk.

column3: To grow in number or quantity: 游客增多 "more tourists", 人数增多, 雨水增多. It is about counting things becoming more, and it describes a state rather than something done to an object. 增 "increase" + 多 "many".
column4: 夏天来了，游客明显增多。
column5: 夏天來了，遊客明顯增多。
column6: Xiàtiān lái le, yóukè míngxiǎn zēngduō.
column7: Summer has come, and the number of tourists has clearly increased.

column3: To strengthen something that already exists, such as strength, confidence, awareness or ability: 增强体质 "build up the body", 增强信心 "boost confidence". The object is an abstract or bodily quality. 增 "increase" + 强 "strong".
column6: Duō yùndòng kěyǐ zēngqiáng tǐzhì.
column7: More exercise can strengthen the body.

column3: To speed up, as a verb: 加速前进 "speed up", 加速发展 "speed up development", 加速度 "acceleration". Unlike 加快, which is common in speech, 加速 is a bit more technical and fits machines and processes. 加 "add" + 速 "speed".
column4: 车子慢慢加速，开上了高速公路。
column5: 車子慢慢加速，開上了高速公路。
column6: Chēzi mànmàn jiāsù, kāishàng le gāosùgōnglù.
column7: The car slowly sped up and drove onto the expressway.

column3: To rise or to raise something in height, level or degree: 气温升高 "the temperature rises", 升高了两米, 血压升高. It is for things that climb along a scale. 升 "rise" + 高 "high".
column4: 天气转暖，气温慢慢升高。
column5: 天氣轉暖，氣溫慢慢升高。
column6: Tiānqì zhuǎn nuǎn, qìwēn mànmàn shēnggāo.
column7: As the weather warms, the temperature rises slowly.

column3: To enlarge or magnify: 放大照片 "enlarge a photo", 放大镜 "magnifying glass", 把声音放大 "turn the sound up". It also means to exaggerate: 放大问题. 放 "put, let go" + 大 "big".
column4: 请把这张照片放大一点儿。
column5: 請把這張照片放大一點兒。
column6: Qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng zhàopiàn fàngdà yīdiǎnr.
column7: Please enlarge this photo a little.

column3: To add something to something else: 一加上二 "one plus two", 加上盐 "add salt". It is also a conjunction, "on top of that, plus", at the start of a clause: 加上天气不好，我们没去. 加 "add" + 上 "on top".
column4: 他很聪明，加上努力，成绩一直很好。
column5: 他很聰明，加上努力，成績一直很好。
column6: Tā hěn cōngming, jiāshang nǔlì, chéngjì yīzhí hěn hǎo.
column7: He is smart, and on top of that he works hard, so his grades have always been good.

column3: To heat something up: 加热食物 "heat food", 加热到一百度 "heat to 100 degrees", 加热器 "heater". The object is the thing being warmed. It is the technical word and the word on microwave and cooking instructions. 加 "add" + 热 "heat".
column6: Bǎ niúnǎi jiārè hòu zài hē.
column7: Heat the milk before you drink it.

column3: Prosperous and thriving, of an economy, a market, a culture or a city: 经济繁荣 "a prosperous economy", 繁荣昌盛 "prosperous and flourishing". It can also be a verb, "to make prosper": 繁荣市场. 繁 is "numerous" and 荣 is "flourishing", a written, positive word.
column4: 这个城市的经济非常繁荣。
column5: 這個城市的經濟非常繁榮。
column6: Zhège chéngshì de jīngjì fēicháng fánróng.
column7: This city's economy is very prosperous.

column3: To restore or to return to a former state: 恢复健康 "recover one's health", 恢复正常 "return to normal", 恢复联系 "reestablish contact". The thing restored is the object, and it can also be intransitive. 恢 is "restore" and 复 is "return", both reversing a loss.
column4: 经过休息，他的体力慢慢恢复了。
column5: 經過休息，他的體力慢慢恢復了。
column6: Jīngguò xiūxi, tā de tǐlì mànmàn huīfù le.
column7: After rest, his strength slowly came back.

column3: To get rid of something unwanted, mostly something abstract: 消除误会 "clear up a misunderstanding", 消除疲劳 "relieve fatigue", 消除疑虑 "dispel doubts". 消 "disappear" + 除 "remove". With the object after it, the result is that the thing no longer exists.
column4: 这次谈话消除了我们之间的误会。
column5: 這次談話消除了我們之間的誤會。
column6: Zhè cì tánhuà xiāochú le wǒmen zhījiān de wùhuì.
column7: This talk cleared up the misunderstanding between us.

column3: To lift, cancel or end something that restricts, such as a contract, a ban, an alert or a relationship: 解除合同 "terminate a contract", 解除警报 "sound the all-clear", 解除误会. It is formal. 解 "untie" + 除 "remove".
column4: 公司解除了和他的合同。
column5: 公司解除了和他的合同。
column6: Gōngsī jiěchú le hé tā de hétong.
column7: The company terminated its contract with him.

column3: To rule out or remove something that stands in the way: 排除困难 "overcome difficulties", 排除可能性 "rule out the possibility", 排除障碍 "clear obstacles". The object is a difficulty or a possibility rather than a person. 排 "push away" + 除 "remove".
column4: 警方没有排除任何可能。
column5: 警方沒有排除任何可能。
column6: Jǐngfāng méiyǒu páichú rènhé kěnéng.
column7: The police have not ruled out any possibility.

column3: To tear down a building or a structure, or to remove a device: 拆除旧楼 "demolish an old building", 拆除炸弹 "defuse a bomb". It is about taking apart something that was built or installed. 拆 "take apart" + 除 "remove".
column4: 这座旧楼下个月就要拆除了。
column5: 這座舊樓下個月就要拆除了。
column6: Zhè zuò jiù lóu xià ge yuè jiù yào chāichú le.
column7: This old building will be torn down next month.

column3: To break off something that was going on, so that it stops, at least for a while: 通话中断 "the call was cut off", 中断学业 "interrupt one's studies", 供电中断 "a power outage". 中 "in the middle" + 断 "break", so the stop happens partway through.
column6: Diànhuà tūrán zhōngduàn le.
column7: The call was suddenly cut off.

column3: To bring to an end, formally, often for contracts, talks, a project or a procedure: 终止合同 "terminate a contract", 终止比赛, 终止谈判. It is the formal word for stopping that is final, unlike 暂停. 终 "end" + 止 "stop".
column6: Shuāngfāng tóngyì zhōngzhǐ hézuò.
column7: Both sides agreed to end the cooperation.

column3: To give up something, such as a plan, a right, a chance or an attempt: 放弃机会 "pass up a chance", 不要放弃 "don't give up", 放弃治疗. The object is what is given up. 放 "let go" + 弃 "abandon".
column4: 不管多难，我都不会放弃。
column5: 不管多難，我都不會放棄。
column6: Bùguǎn duō nán, wǒ dōu bù huì fàngqì.
column7: No matter how hard it is, I will not give up.

column3: To avoid something or someone on purpose, not to face it: 回避问题 "dodge a question", 回避矛盾 "avoid conflict", 不要回避. It also means to step aside for a conflict of interest (a judge who recuses himself). 回 "turn back" + 避 "avoid". Taiwan writes it 迴避.
column6: Tā zǒngshì huíbì zhège wèntí.
column7: He always avoids this question.

column3: To collect something back for reuse or return: 回收垃圾 "collect waste for recycling", 回收旧手机, 资源回收 "recycling". It can also mean to recover a cost or a product: 回收成本. 回 "back" + 收 "collect".
column4: 这些旧衣服可以回收再利用。
column5: 這些舊衣服可以回收再利用。
column6: Zhèxiē jiù yīfu kěyǐ huíshōu zài lìyòng.
column7: These old clothes can be collected and reused.

column3: To clear out or sort through something to get rid of what is not needed: 清理房间 "clean up a room", 清理垃圾, 清理账目 "settle accounts". It stresses a thorough sort and removal. 清 "clear" + 理 "put in order".
column4: 周末我要清理一下书房。
column5: 週末我要清理一下書房。
column6: Zhōumò wǒ yào qīnglǐ yīxià shūfáng.
column7: I will tidy up the study this weekend.

column3: To tidy or put things in order, to pack, and also to fix or punish someone: 收拾房间 "tidy the room", 收拾行李 "pack luggage", 看我怎么收拾你 "just watch how I'll deal with you". The second syllable is neutral. 收 "gather" + 拾 "pick up".
column4: 吃完饭后，我帮妈妈收拾桌子。
column5: 吃完飯後，我幫媽媽收拾桌子。
column6: Chī wán fàn hòu, wǒ bāng māma shōushi zhuōzi.
column7: After the meal, I helped Mom clear the table.

column3: To pause or suspend something for the time being: 暂停营业 "closed for the time being", 暂停比赛 "pause the match", and the pause button on a player. 暂 means "temporary", which marks the stop as one that will end. The opposite idea of a final stop is 终止.
column6: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, bǐsài zàntíng le.
column7: The match was suspended because of the rain.

column3: The end of a route or a race, where one finishes: 到达终点 "reach the finish line", 终点站 "terminal station", 终点线. The opposite is 起点. It is also used for the end of a process or journey in a general sense. 终 "end" + 点 "point".
column4: 他第一个冲过了终点线。
column5: 他第一個衝過了終點線。
column6: Tā dì-yī ge chōngguò le zhōngdiǎn xiàn.
column7: He was the first to dash across the finish line.

column3: To lighten or reduce a burden, pain, pressure or punishment: 减轻负担 "lighten the burden", 减轻压力, 减轻痛苦. It is for things felt as heavy, and the object is that weight. 减 "reduce" + 轻 "light".
column6: Zhè zhǒng yào kěyǐ jiǎnqīng téngtòng.
column7: This medicine can ease the pain.

column3: To wait for someone or something, more formal and polite than 等: 等候通知 "wait for notice", 在门口等候, 恭候 is higher still. It is common on signs and in service talk, as in 请在这里等候. 等 "wait" + 候 "await".
column4: 请在大厅等候，医生马上就来。
column5: 請在大廳等候，醫生馬上就來。
column6: Qǐng zài dàtīng děnghòu, yīshēng mǎshàng jiù lái.
column7: Please wait in the hall; the doctor will be right here.

column3: To stay or remain in a place, a spoken sense: 待在家里 "stay at home", 待一会儿 "stay for a while", 待不下去 "can't stand staying". It is pronounced dai1 in this sense, and dai4 in 对待 "treat" and 招待 "entertain". It is a spoken word and takes a place word afterwards.
column4: 周末我想待在家里休息。
column5: 週末我想待在家裡休息。
column6: Zhōumò wǒ xiǎng dāi zài jiālǐ xiūxi.
column7: I want to stay at home and rest this weekend.

column3: Blank, stunned or slow: 发呆 "stare blankly", 吓呆了 "stunned with fear", 呆呆地 "in a daze". It describes a face or person without reaction, and in speech it is also a variant of 待 "to stay" (呆在家里). The character is 口 over 木, a plain shape that is a good one to learn as a unit.
column4: 听到这个消息，他整个人都呆了。
column5: 聽到這個消息，他整個人都呆了。
column6: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā zhěng ge rén dōu dāi le.
column7: On hearing the news, he was struck dumb.

column3: To stay in a place for a time, not long and not permanently, as on a trip or in transit: 停留三天 "stay three days", 在北京停留. It can also mean to remain at a stage: 停留在原地. 停 "stop" + 留 "stay".
column4: 我们在上海停留了三天。
column5: 我們在上海停留了三天。
column6: Wǒmen zài Shànghǎi tíngliú le sān tiān.
column7: We stayed in Shanghai for three days.

column3: Late, delayed, or slow: 迟到 "arrive late", 迟早 "sooner or later", 不迟 "not late", 推迟 "postpone". On its own it is mostly in compounds, but 来迟了 "came late" is possible. The 辶 shows movement, fitting something that is slow to arrive.
column6: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ lái chí le.
column7: Sorry, I'm late.

column3: The arrival of something, often a season, a time or an event, in a written style: 春天的到来 "the arrival of spring", 迎接新年的到来, and also a verb: 假期即将到来. It is not used for people arriving. 到 "arrive" + 来 "come".
column4: 春天的到来让大家心情很好。
column5: 春天的到來讓大家心情很好。
column6: Chūntiān de dàolái ràng dàjiā xīnqíng hěn hǎo.
column7: The arrival of spring puts everyone in a good mood.

column3: The right moment for an action, an opportunity as a matter of timing: 把握时机 "seize the moment", 时机成熟 "the time is ripe", 等待时机. It is not just "time"; it implies the point at which something will work. 时 "time" + 机 "chance".
column4: 现在还不是出手的时机。
column5: 現在還不是出手的時機。
column6: Xiànzài hái bù shì chūshǒu de shíjī.
column7: Now is not yet the time to act.

column3: Current affairs, the news of the day: 关心时事 "follow current affairs", 时事新闻, 时事评论 "commentary on current events". It is the topic of newspapers and talk shows. 时 "time" + 事 "matter".
column4: 他每天看报纸，很关心时事。
column5: 他每天看報紙，很關心時事。
column6: Tā měi tiān kàn bàozhǐ, hěn guānxīn shíshì.
column7: He reads the paper every day and follows current affairs closely.

column3: A major matter, an important event: 国家大事 "affairs of state", 终身大事 "the big event of a lifetime, marriage", 大事不好 "something terrible has happened". The opposite is 小事. 大事 is also used with 化小 in the saying 大事化小，小事化了. Treat it as two words in the sentence, as 大 modifies 事.
column4: 结婚是人生中的一件大事。
column5: 結婚是人生中的一件大事。
column6: Jiéhūn shì rénshēng zhōng de yī jiàn dàshì.
column7: Getting married is a major event in life.

column3: To prepare or get ready, either as a verb or as a modifier: 预备好了吗 "are you ready", 预备考试, 预备班. It is a bit more formal than 准备 and often for preparing in advance. The command 预备，开始！ is "ready, begin!". 预 "in advance" + 备 "prepare".
column4: 孩子们正在预备明天的考试。
column5: 孩子們正在預備明天的考試。
column6: Háizimen zhèngzài yùbèi míngtiān de kǎoshì.
column7: The children are getting ready for tomorrow's exam.

column3: In a row, one after another: 接连几天 "for several days in a row", 接连三次, 接连发生. It comes before the verb as an adverb and is used for events of the same kind that follow each other quickly. 接 "join" + 连 "link".
column4: 这个月接连下了好几场大雨。
column5: 這個月接連下了好幾場大雨。
column6: Zhège yuè jiēlián xià le hǎo jǐ chǎng dàyǔ.
column7: It has rained heavily several times in a row this month.

column3: Frequent, often, and used as an adjective or adverb: 频繁出现 "appear frequently", 联系频繁, 频繁地使用. It sounds written and suits formal writing and reports. For daily speech 经常 is more common. 频 means "frequent" and 繁 "numerous".
column6: Zuìjìn tā chūchāi hěn pínfán.
column7: He has been on business trips very often lately.

column3: To mention or bring up a topic: 提起这件事 "mention this matter", 别提起 "don't bring it up". It also means to lift up or arouse: 提起精神 "pick up one's spirits", and to start a lawsuit: 提起诉讼. 提 "carry, raise" + 起 "up".
column4: 她从来不愿提起过去的事。
column5: 她從來不願提起過去的事。
column6: Tā cónglái bù yuàn tíqǐ guòqù de shì.
column7: She has never been willing to talk about the past.

column3: To encourage someone: 鼓励孩子 "encourage a child", 受到鼓励 "feel encouraged", and also a noun, "encouragement". The pattern is 鼓励 + person + verb: 鼓励他继续努力. 鼓 is a drum, so the word is like beating the drum to spur someone on, and 励 means "urge".
column4: 老师鼓励我们多说汉语。
column5: 老師鼓勵我們多說漢語。
column6: Lǎoshī gǔlì wǒmen duō shuō Hànyǔ.
column7: The teacher encourages us to speak more Chinese.

column3: To mobilize people for a task or a campaign: 动员群众 "rally the masses", 总动员 "full mobilization", 动员大会. It also means to persuade someone to do something: 动员他参加. It has a political and organizational flavor. 动 "move" + 员 "member".
column4: 学校动员大家参加植树活动。
column5: 學校動員大家參加植樹活動。
column6: Xuéxiào dòngyuán dàjiā cānjiā zhíshù huódòng.
column7: The school mobilized everyone to take part in the tree planting.

column3: To refuse a request, invitation, offer or demand: 拒绝邀请 "decline an invitation", 被拒绝 "be rejected", 拒绝回答. It is clear and firm, stronger than the soft 谢绝 and less formal than 驳回. 拒 "resist" + 绝 "cut off".
column4: 他礼貌地拒绝了我们的邀请。
column5: 他禮貌地拒絕了我們的邀請。
column6: Tā lǐmào de jùjué le wǒmen de yāoqǐng.
column7: He politely declined our invitation.

column3: To blame or criticize someone openly for a fault: 指责别人 "criticize others", 受到指责 "come under criticism", 互相指责 "blame each other". It is stronger than 批评 and implies accusing. 指 "point at" + 责 "blame".
column4: 他不应该指责朋友的错误。
column5: 他不應該指責朋友的錯誤。
column6: Tā bù yīnggāi zhǐzé péngyou de cuòwù.
column7: He should not blame his friend for the mistake.

column3: To force or compel someone to do something: 强迫他做 "force him to do it", 强迫症 "obsessive-compulsive disorder", 被强迫. It is read qiang3 here, not qiang2 "strong". 强 "force" + 迫 "press".
column4: 没有人可以强迫你做不喜欢的事。
column5: 沒有人可以強迫你做不喜歡的事。
column6: Méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qiǎngpò nǐ zuò bù xǐhuan de shì.
column7: No one can force you to do something you don't like.

column3: To make things hard for someone, or to feel awkward: 别为难他 "don't make it hard for him", 感到为难 "feel in a bind", 很为难. Read wei2 here, not wei4. It can be a transitive verb with a person after it or a state of embarrassment. 为 "make, act" + 难 "hard".
column4: 你别为难他，他也是照规定办事。
column5: 你別為難他，他也是照規定辦事。
column6: Nǐ bié wéinán tā, tā yě shì zhào guīdìng bànshì.
column7: Don't make things hard for him; he is just following the rules.

column3: To disturb or bother someone: 打扰一下 "excuse me for a moment", 不好意思打扰了 "sorry to bother you", 请勿打扰 "do not disturb". It is the polite formula for interrupting. 打 "do" + 扰 "disturb".
column6: Bù hǎoyìsi, dǎrǎo nǐ yīxià.
column7: Sorry, may I bother you for a moment?

column3: To control or dominate, or to allocate and arrange: 支配时间 "manage one's time", 自由支配 "free to dispose of", 被支配. The word suggests that someone has the right to decide how something is used. 支 "branch out, pay out" + 配 "match, allot".
column4: 他可以自由支配自己的时间。
column5: 他可以自由支配自己的時間。
column6: Tā kěyǐ zìyóu zhīpèi zìjǐ de shíjiān.
column7: He can manage his own time freely.

column3: To urge someone to do or stop doing something, by talking: 劝他别去 "advise him not to go", 劝架 "try to stop a quarrel", 劝告 "advice". It is gentler than 强迫 and often means talking someone out of something. The 力 on the right is effort.
column6: Péngyou quàn wǒ zǎodiǎn xiūxi.
column7: My friend urged me to get to bed early.

column3: To call on people to act, with the authority of a leader or an organization: 号召大家 "call on everyone", 响应号召 "answer the call", 发出号召. It is formal and used in public speech. 号 "call" + 召 "summon".
column4: 学校号召同学们节约用水。
column5: 學校號召同學們節約用水。
column6: Xuéxiào hàozhào tóngxuémen jiéyuē yòngshuǐ.
column7: The school called on the students to save water.

column3: To order someone to do something, and the order itself: 下命令 "give an order", 服从命令 "obey an order", 命令他离开 "order him to leave". It comes from a superior to a subordinate. 命 "command" + 令 "order".
column4: 长官命令士兵立刻出发。
column5: 長官命令士兵立刻出發。
column6: Zhǎngguān mìnglìng shìbīng lìkè chūfā.
column7: The officer ordered the soldiers to set out at once.

column3: To scold, swear at or curse someone: 骂人 "swear at people", 挨骂 "get scolded", 被老板骂了. The two 口 on top are mouths, a good picture for noisy scolding. 骂 is also found in 骂街 and 谩骂, though 骂人 is the usual use.
column4: 他因为迟到被老师骂了。
column5: 他因為遲到被老師罵了。
column6: Tā yīnwèi chídào bèi lǎoshī mà le.
column7: He was scolded by the teacher for being late.

column3: To possess or own, a formal word usually about big or valuable things: 拥有土地 "own land", 拥有财富, 拥有丰富的经验 "have rich experience". It is not used for small things such as a pen. 拥 "hold" + 有 "have".
column4: 这家公司拥有三千名员工。
column5: 這家公司擁有三千名員工。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī yōngyǒu sānqiān míng yuángōng.
column7: This company has three thousand employees.

column3: To have or possess, used with an abstract noun and a written feel: 有着悠久的历史 "have a long history", 有着重要的意义, 有着不同的看法. 着 is the verbal particle, neutral, and it makes the phrase sound slightly literary. It is rarely used with ordinary concrete things.
column4: 这座城市有着两千年的历史。
column5: 這座城市有著兩千年的歷史。
column6: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒuzhe liǎng qiān nián de lìshǐ.
column7: This city has a history of two thousand years.

column3: To carry or have a certain quality, feeling or element: 带有感情 "carry feeling", 带有地方色彩 "have a local flavor", 带有危险性. The thing it has is a trait or an element, not an object. 带 "bring, carry" + 有 "have".
column4: 他的话带有明显的讽刺意味。
column5: 他的話帶有明顯的諷刺意味。
column6: Tā de huà dàiyǒu míngxiǎn de fěngcì yìwèi.
column7: His words carry an obvious note of sarcasm.

column3: To be in a certain situation or stage: 处在困难时期 "be in a difficult period", 处在发展阶段 "be at the stage of development". It is followed by an abstract place, such as a state or period. 处 is read chu3 here, "be located", and 在 "at".
column4: 这个行业正处在快速发展的阶段。
column5: 這個行業正處在快速發展的階段。
column6: Zhège hángyè zhèng chǔzài kuàisù fāzhǎn de jiēduàn.
column7: This industry is in a stage of rapid development.

column3: From within it, from among them: 从中学到 "learn from it", 从中选择 "choose from among them", 从中获得. 中 refers back to something just mentioned. It comes before a verb, and the thing it points to has to be clear from before.
column4: 我们可以从中学到很多经验。
column5: 我們可以從中學到很多經驗。
column6: Wǒmen kěyǐ cóngzhōng xuédào hěn duō jīngyàn.
column7: We can learn a lot of lessons from it.

column3: To mean or to imply, of a result or consequence, not of a word's meaning: 这意味着… "this means…", 意味着成功 "mean success". It links a fact to what follows from it, which makes it good for explanations. 意味 "meaning, flavor" + 着.
column4: 学习外语意味着打开一个新世界。
column5: 學習外語意味著打開一個新世界。
column6: Xuéxí wàiyǔ yìwèizhe dǎkāi yī ge xīn shìjiè.
column7: Learning a foreign language means opening up a new world.

column3: An exception, and "to be an exception": 没有例外 "without exception", 也不例外 "is no exception", 例外情况. The usual pattern is 也不例外 after a statement that applies to others as well. 例 "example, rule" + 外 "outside".
column4: 每个人都要遵守规定，我也不例外。
column5: 每個人都要遵守規定，我也不例外。
column6: Měi ge rén dōu yào zūnshǒu guīdìng, wǒ yě bù lìwài.
column7: Everyone has to follow the rules, and I am no exception.

column3: An analogy or example, and "for instance": 打个比方 "to take an analogy", 比方说 "let's say, for example". The second syllable is neutral. In speech 比方说 is the way to introduce an example, and 打比方 means to give an illustration.
column4: 你打个比方，我就明白了。
column5: 你打個比方，我就明白了。
column6: Nǐ dǎ ge bǐfang, wǒ jiù míngbai le.
column7: Give me an analogy and I will understand.

column3: To be left over, or what remains: 剩下的钱 "the remaining money", 只剩下三个 "only three are left", 剩下的时间. 剩 alone does the same, but 剩下 is the natural form with 的 in front of a noun. It is a verb, and also takes an object.
column6: Zhège yuè zhǐ shèngxià jǐ tiān le.
column7: Only a few days are left in this month.

column3: To own or hold, and to account for a share: 占有市场 "hold a share of the market", 占有率 "market share", 占有一席之地 "have a place". It is more formal than 有, and for resources, land or a percentage. Read zhan4. 占 and 有 both indicate holding.
column4: 这家公司占有百分之三十的市场。
column5: 這家公司佔有百分之三十的市場。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhànyǒu bǎi fēn zhī sānshí de shìchǎng.
column7: This company holds thirty percent of the market.

column3: To correspond to, or corresponding: 一一对应 "one-to-one correspondence", 对应的字 "the corresponding character". It is used when two things match in a system, such as a word and its translation. 对 "face, pair" + 应 "answer"; here 应 is read ying4.
column4: 每个汉字都有对应的拼音。
column5: 每個漢字都有對應的拼音。
column6: Měi ge Hànzì dōu yǒu duìyìng de pīnyīn.
column7: Every Chinese character has a corresponding pinyin.

column3: Corresponding or appropriate, before a noun or a verb: 采取相应措施 "take appropriate measures", 相应的变化 "a corresponding change". It does not stand as a main verb in everyday talk. 相 "mutually" + 应 "respond", read ying4.
column4: 价格上涨，销量也相应下降。
column5: 價格上漲，銷量也相應下降。
column6: Jiàgé shàngzhǎng, xiāoliàng yě xiāngyìng xiàjiàng.
column7: Prices went up, and sales fell accordingly.
