column3: Equal, in number, size or value: 两边相等 "both sides are equal", 数量相等, 大小相等. It is a stative adjective and does not take a degree word. 相 "mutually" + 等 "equal", so it describes two things matching each other.
column6: Zhè liǎng ge shù xiāngděng.
column7: These two numbers are equal.

column3: Each other, both sides: 彼此了解 "understand each other", 彼此彼此 "the same to you", 彼此之间 "between each other". It works as a pronoun like 互相 but sits as the subject or object. 彼 is "that" and 此 "this", so the word means "that and this".
column6: Wǒmen bǐcǐ dōu hěn liǎojiě.
column7: We understand each other well.

column3: To be left over: 剩饭 "leftover food", 剩下 "remain", 只剩一个 "only one left". Written alone it is common with a number: 还剩两天. The leftover is the subject or the object: 菜剩了很多 "a lot of food is left".
column6: Pánzi lǐ hái shèng yī kuài dàngāo.
column7: One piece of cake is left on the plate.

column3: Must, certainly, necessarily: 必须 "must", 必然 "inevitable", 必要 "necessary", and in the written 必定 "certainly". On its own it appears in formal and set phrases such as 事必躬亲, 未必 "not necessarily", and 不必 "need not". Learn it as the first character of those words.
column6: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ bùbì dānxīn.
column7: You don't need to worry about this.

column3: Essential, indispensable, something that cannot be done without: 生活必需品 "daily necessities", 必需的条件. It is often confused with 必须 "must"; 必需 is about need and is used before a noun, while 必须 is an adverb before a verb. 需 means "need".
column6: Shuǐ shì shēnghuó bìxū de.
column7: Water is essential for life.

column3: Cannot not, which means must: 不能不去 "must go", 不能不承认 "have to admit". The double negative is a bit stronger than 必须 and implies that there is no choice, because of circumstance. 不能 "cannot" + 不 "not".
column4: 这次会议我们不能不去。
column5: 這次會議我們不能不去。
column6: Zhè cì huìyì wǒmen bùnéngbù qù.
column7: We have to go to this meeting.

column3: Not to need, or there is no need: 用不着担心 "no need to worry", 用不着你管 "it's none of your business". The 不 in the middle is a neutral 不, and the pattern V + 不着 means "not able to". In 用不着 the 着 is zhao2, not the particle zhe5. The opposite is 用得着.
column4: 这点小事用不着麻烦别人。
column5: 這點小事用不著麻煩別人。
column6: Zhè diǎn xiǎo shì yòngbuzháo máfan biéren.
column7: There is no need to trouble others for such a small matter.

column3: Cannot help doing something, cannot hold back: 忍不住笑了 "couldn't help laughing", 忍不住哭 "can't help crying". It comes before the verb and means the action happens against one's will. The pattern V + 不住 means "cannot hold". The opposite is 忍得住.
column4: 听到这个笑话，大家都忍不住笑了。
column5: 聽到這個笑話，大家都忍不住笑了。
column6: Tīngdào zhège xiàohua, dàjiā dōu rěnbuzhù xiào le.
column7: Hearing the joke, everyone could not help laughing.

column3: To be unwilling to part with or to use up, out of attachment: 舍不得你 "I hate to leave you", 舍不得花钱 "hate to spend money", 舍不得扔. Read the first syllable she3, "let go". The pattern V + 不得 here is "cannot bear to". The positive form is 舍得.
column4: 我舍不得扔掉这件旧毛衣。
column5: 我捨不得扔掉這件舊毛衣。
column6: Wǒ shěbude rēngdiào zhè jiàn jiù máoyī.
column7: I can't bear to throw away this old sweater.

column3: To be willing to part with or spend something valuable: 舍得花钱 "willing to spend money", 舍得吃 "not stingy about food". It is usually used in questions and negatives, or in the sentence 你舍得吗？. It is the positive of 舍不得, and the 得 is neutral.
column4: 他舍得为孩子的教育花钱。
column5: 他捨得為孩子的教育花錢。
column6: Tā shěde wèi háizi de jiàoyù huā qián.
column7: He is willing to spend money on his child's education.

column3: A polite reply to praise or kindness: "I don't deserve it, you flatter me". It literally means "I dare not accept". It is said in modest, polished talk, usually after a compliment, and is somewhat old-fashioned. 当 here is read dang1, "accept".
column4: 您过奖了，我真是不敢当。
column5: 您過獎了，我真是不敢當。
column6: Nín guòjiǎng le, wǒ zhēn shì bùgǎndāng.
column7: You flatter me, I really don't deserve it.

column3: Terrible, serious, and as a complement "extremely": 不得了了 "it's a disaster", 高兴得不得了 "extremely happy", 疼得不得了. The pattern is adjective + 得 + 不得了, and it is spoken. 得了 is read de2liao3 in it.
column4: 他高兴得不得了，一直在笑。
column5: 他高興得不得了，一直在笑。
column6: Tā gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo, yīzhí zài xiào.
column7: He is so happy that he keeps laughing.

column3: Enough! or "all right!", a spoken way to cut someone short or to agree to leave something: 得了，别说了 "that's enough, stop talking". Spoken, with a slightly annoyed or resigned tone. It is read de2le5, and 得了 as a verb phrase "can be done" is de2liao3.
column4: 得了，别说了，我已经知道了。
column5: 得了，別說了，我已經知道了。
column6: Déle, bié shuō le, wǒ yǐjīng zhīdào le.
column7: All right, stop talking, I already know.

column3: Finished, or "it's all over": 完了完了 "oh no, I'm doomed", 这下完了 "now we're in trouble". It is a spoken exclamation for bad news. Without a bad meaning, 完了 means "it is finished", as in 说完了. Note that the 了 is neutral.
column4: 糟了，我把钥匙忘在家里了，完了！
column5: 糟了，我把鑰匙忘在家裡了，完了！
column6: Zāo le, wǒ bǎ yàoshi wàng zài jiālǐ le, wánle!
column7: Oh no, I forgot my keys at home, I'm done for!

column3: To disregard or ignore, usually a danger or a cost: 不顾危险 "regardless of danger", 不顾一切 "at all costs", 不顾家人反对. It describes a bold or reckless choice. 顾 means "care about, look after", so the word is "not care about".
column4: 他不顾危险，跳进水里救人。
column5: 他不顧危險，跳進水裡救人。
column6: Tā bùgù wēixiǎn, tiàojìn shuǐ lǐ jiù rén.
column7: Disregarding the danger, he jumped into the water to save someone.

column3: Thus, thereby, as a result: it joins a second action to the first as its result or purpose, with the same subject. 采取措施，从而提高效率 "take measures and thereby raise efficiency". It is a written conjunction, rarely spoken.
column4: 他每天锻炼，从而保持了健康。
column5: 他每天鍛鍊，從而保持了健康。
column6: Tā měi tiān duànliàn, cóng'ér bǎochí le jiànkāng.
column7: He exercises every day and so stays healthy.

column3: Therefore, and as a result: it states a result after a cause that has already been given. 他很努力，因而成绩很好. It is written, and the cause comes first, unlike 所以, which is spoken and often paired with 因为.
column4: 天气很冷，因而路上的人很少。
column5: 天氣很冷，因而路上的人很少。
column6: Tiānqì hěn lěng, yīn'ér lùshàng de rén hěn shǎo.
column7: It was very cold, so there were few people on the road.

column3: So that or in order to, introducing the purpose of the earlier clause: 早点出发，以便赶上火车 "set off early so as to catch the train". It starts a second clause and has a more formal ring than 为了. The purpose is stated after it.
column4: 请留下电话号码，以便我们联系你。
column5: 請留下電話號碼，以便我們聯繫你。
column6: Qǐng liúxià diànhuà hàomǎ, yǐbiàn wǒmen liánxì nǐ.
column7: Please leave a phone number so that we can contact you.

column3: From this, hence: it takes what was just said as the starting point for a conclusion. 由此可见 "from this it can be seen", 由此看来 "judging from this". It is formal and normally used at the start of a clause, in a text.
column4: 他每天练习，由此可见他很努力。
column5: 他每天練習，由此可見他很努力。
column6: Tā měi tiān liànxí, yóucǐ kějiàn tā hěn nǔlì.
column7: He practices every day, which shows he works hard.

column3: Like this, so, in this way: 如此重要 "so important", 如此而已 "that's all", 事实如此 "that's how it is". It is the written counterpart of 这样 and stands in for something just described. It can be a predicate on its own: 情况如此. 如 "like" + 此 "this".
column4: 他如此努力，一定会成功。
column5: 他如此努力，一定會成功。
column6: Tā rúcǐ nǔlì, yīdìng huì chénggōng.
column7: He works so hard that he is sure to succeed.

column3: Like or just as, in a comparison: 如同朋友一样 "just like a friend", 如同做梦 "as if in a dream". It is a written equivalent of 像 and often has 一样 or 一般 at the end. 如 and 同 both mean "like".
column4: 她对我如同亲姐姐一样。
column5: 她對我如同親姐姐一樣。
column6: Tā duì wǒ rútóng qīn jiějie yīyàng.
column7: She treats me just like a real older sister.

column3: As follows, introducing a list or the text that comes next: 内容如下 "the contents are as follows", 具体如下, 办法如下. It sits at the end of a clause and a colon follows. It is a written, formal word for notices and reports.
column4: 会议时间和地点如下：周五下午三点，二楼会议室。
column5: 會議時間和地點如下：週五下午三點，二樓會議室。
column6: Huìyì shíjiān hé dìdiǎn rúxià: zhōuwǔ xiàwǔ sān diǎn, èr lóu huìyìshì.
column7: The time and place of the meeting are as follows: Friday at three p.m., conference room on the second floor.

column3: Just as, introducing a comparison with something known or said before: 正如你所说 "just as you said", 正如大家所知. It begins a clause that is a comparison and is followed by a clause saying that the same holds here. 正 "just" + 如 "like".
column4: 正如你所说，学习需要耐心。
column5: 正如你所說，學習需要耐心。
column6: Zhèngrú nǐ suǒ shuō, xuéxí xūyào nàixīn.
column7: Just as you said, learning takes patience.

column3: Along with, as, in step with a change: 随着时间的推移 "as time goes by", 随着经济的发展 "with economic development". It introduces a change that happens together with another, and the second clause says what follows. It cannot take a person to follow, unlike 跟着.
column4: 随着生活水平的提高，人们越来越注意健康。
column5: 隨著生活水平的提高，人們越來越注意健康。
column6: Suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng de tígāo, rénmen yuè lái yuè zhùyì jiànkāng.
column7: As living standards rise, people pay more and more attention to health.

column3: Out of, from a motive: 出于好心 "out of good intentions", 出于礼貌 "out of politeness", 出于安全考虑. The motive follows 出于 and the action follows. It names the reason behind a deed, in a written style. 出 "come out" + 于 "from".
column6: Tā chūyú lǐmào, méiyǒu jùjué.
column7: Out of politeness, he did not refuse.

column3: To base on, and the basis itself: 依据法律 "according to the law", 没有依据 "without grounds", 科学依据 "scientific basis". As a verb it takes an object, like 根据; as a noun it is "evidence". 依 "rely on" + 据 "according to".
column4: 法官依据法律作出了判决。
column5: 法官依據法律作出了判決。
column6: Fǎguān yījù fǎlǜ zuòchū le pànjué.
column7: The judge made the ruling on the basis of the law.

column3: According to, in line with a rule, plan or standard: 依照规定 "according to the regulations", 依照程序 "following the procedure". It is stricter than 按照, since the standard must be followed. 照 means "follow, match".
column6: Qǐng yīzhào shuōmíngshū ānzhuāng.
column7: Please install it in accordance with the instructions.

column3: To rely on, to go by, or "on the basis of": 凭票入场 "enter with a ticket", 凭什么 "on what grounds?", 凭本事吃饭 "live by one's skill". 凭什么 is also the spoken way to protest. It is also a verb meaning to lean on: 凭窗远望. Learn the pattern 凭 + the thing relied on + verb.
column4: 进入景区需要凭票入场。
column5: 進入景區需要憑票入場。
column6: Jìnrù jǐngqū xūyào píng piào rù chǎng.
column7: You need a ticket to get into the scenic area.

column3: To take as the main thing, to be mainly: 以…为主 "be mainly…", 以学习为主 "study is the main thing", 以中餐为主. It is always in the pattern 以 A 为主, with A as the main part. 为 is read wei2 here.
column4: 我们公司的客户以年轻人为主。
column5: 我們公司的客戶以年輕人為主。
column6: Wǒmen gōngsī de kèhù yǐ niánqīngrén wéizhǔ.
column7: Our company's customers are mainly young people.

column3: Up to, until, the limit of a time or stage: 到今天为止 "up to today", 到目前为止 "so far", 今天就到这里为止 "that's all for today". It always follows a time phrase starting with 到 or 至, and says that a state lasts up to that point.
column4: 到目前为止，我已经学了五百个汉字。
column5: 到目前為止，我已經學了五百個漢字。
column6: Dào mùqián wéizhǐ, wǒ yǐjīng xué le wǔbǎi ge Hànzì.
column7: Up to now, I have learned five hundred characters.

column3: Lasting for, with a set time limit: 为期三天 "lasting three days", 为期一年的课程. It is followed by the length of time and works as a predicate before a noun or at the beginning of a clause. It is for events with a fixed duration, and is written.
column6: Zhè cì péixùn wéiqī yī zhōu.
column7: This training lasts one week.

column3: To be used for or applied to: 用于教学 "used for teaching", 用于治疗 "used in treatment", 这种技术用于… The use or the field follows. It is a passive-like, written pattern, and 用在 is the spoken one. 用 "use" + 于 "for".
column4: 这种材料主要用于建筑。
column5: 這種材料主要用於建築。
column6: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào zhǔyào yòngyú jiànzhù.
column7: This material is mainly used in construction.

column3: To be used for, followed by a verb for the purpose: 用来写字 "used for writing", 用来做饭 "used for cooking". The object being used comes first, as a topic: 这把刀用来切肉. After 用来 comes a verb, not a noun, which is the difference from 用于.
column4: 这把刀是用来切水果的。
column5: 這把刀是用來切水果的。
column6: Zhè bǎ dāo shì yònglái qiē shuǐguǒ de.
column7: This knife is used for cutting fruit.

column3: Easy to, convenient for doing: 便于携带 "easy to carry", 便于管理 "easy to manage", 便于使用. A verb follows it, and the pattern states the advantage of the thing. It is formal and common in descriptions of products. 便 "convenient" + 于 "for".
column6: Zhè zhǒng bāo hěn qīng, biànyú xiédài.
column7: This kind of bag is light and easy to carry.

column3: To be beneficial for: 有利于健康 "good for health", 有利于发展, 不利于 as the opposite. The thing helped comes after it, and it can be a noun or a verb phrase. 有利 "advantageous" + 于 "for". It is more formal than 对…有好处.
column4: 多喝水有利于身体健康。
column5: 多喝水有利於身體健康。
column6: Duō hē shuǐ yǒulìyú shēntǐ jiànkāng.
column7: Drinking more water is good for your health.

column3: A motive or the reason behind an action: 学习动机 "motivation to study", 犯罪动机 "motive for a crime", 动机不纯 "impure motive". 动 "move, act" + 机 "opportunity, mechanism". It sounds more serious than 目的 and often shows up in talk of behavior.
column4: 他的动机是想帮助别人。
column5: 他的動機是想幫助別人。
column6: Tā de dòngjī shì xiǎng bāngzhù biéren.
column7: His motive was to help others.

column3: To try or attempt, often without success, in a written style: 试图逃跑 "try to escape", 试图解释 "attempt to explain". It is followed by a verb and suggests a plan whose result is uncertain. 试 "try" + 图 "plan, aim". It is more formal than 想 or 试着.
column4: 他试图说服父母，但没有成功。
column5: 他試圖說服父母，但沒有成功。
column6: Tā shìtú shuōfú fùmǔ, dàn méiyǒu chénggōng.
column7: He tried to persuade his parents but did not succeed.

column3: A plan on a large scale, and to plan: 城市规划 "urban planning", 职业规划 "career planning", 规划未来. It is longer-range and more systematic than 计划. 规 "rule, regulate" + 划 "mark out", read hua4 here.
column4: 他正在认真规划自己的未来。
column5: 他正在認真規劃自己的未來。
column6: Tā zhèngzài rènzhēn guīhuà zìjǐ de wèilái.
column7: He is carefully planning his future.

column3: To seek something such as help, a solution or a way out, in a formal manner: 寻求帮助 "seek help", 寻求答案 "look for an answer", 寻求支持. It is for something abstract; for objects use 寻找. 寻 "look for" + 求 "seek".
column4: 遇到困难时，要学会寻求帮助。
column5: 遇到困難時，要學會尋求幫助。
column6: Yùdào kùnnan shí, yào xuéhuì xúnqiú bāngzhù.
column7: When you run into difficulty, you should learn to ask for help.

column3: A means or a method of reaching a goal, often with a hint of tricks: 采取手段 "adopt measures", 不择手段 "by any means", 技术手段 "technical means". The context decides whether it is neutral or negative. 手 "hand" + 段 "section".
column4: 他想用别的手段解决问题。
column5: 他想用別的手段解決問題。
column6: Tā xiǎng yòng bié de shǒuduàn jiějué wèntí.
column7: He wants to solve the problem by other means.

column3: A technique or a way of working, especially in art, writing and crime: 艺术手法 "artistic technique", 写作手法 "writing technique", 作案手法 "method of committing a crime". It is about style and manner more than about the result. 手 "hand" + 法 "way".
column4: 这位作家的写作手法很特别。
column5: 這位作家的寫作手法很特別。
column6: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de xiězuò shǒufǎ hěn tèbié.
column7: This writer's way of writing is very distinctive.

column3: To break through a barrier or limit, literally or figuratively, and a breakthrough: 突破记录 "break a record", 突破难关 "get past a difficulty", 取得突破. It suits records, bottlenecks and defenses. 突 "burst" + 破 "break".
column4: 这位运动员突破了世界纪录。
column5: 這位運動員突破了世界紀錄。
column6: Zhè wèi yùndòngyuán tūpò le shìjiè jìlù.
column7: This athlete broke the world record.

column3: To surpass or go beyond a limit, a rival or one's former self: 超越自我 "surpass oneself", 超越极限 "go beyond limits", 超越时代. It is more figurative and positive than 超过, and the object is often abstract. 超 "exceed" + 越 "cross over".
column4: 他每天都在努力超越昨天的自己。
column5: 他每天都在努力超越昨天的自己。
column6: Tā měi tiān dōu zài nǔlì chāoyuè zuótiān de zìjǐ.
column7: Every day he works hard to surpass his self of yesterday.

column3: To start up a machine or a program, and figuratively to launch a plan: 启动电脑 "start the computer", 启动项目 "launch a project", 启动仪式 "launching ceremony". 启 "open" + 动 "move". It is the word for the start of something that then keeps going.
column4: 我按了一下按钮，机器就启动了。
column5: 我按了一下按鈕，機器就啟動了。
column6: Wǒ àn le yīxià ànniǔ, jīqì jiù qǐdòng le.
column7: I pressed the button and the machine started up.

column3: To carry out a plan or policy in practice, and to make sure of details: 落实政策 "implement a policy", 落实责任 "pin down responsibility", 还没落实 "not yet settled". It means turning words into action, so it goes with plans, policies and tasks. 落 "fall, land" + 实 "real".
column4: 这个计划还需要具体落实。
column5: 這個計畫還需要具體落實。
column6: Zhège jìhuà hái xūyào jùtǐ luòshí.
column7: This plan still needs to be carried out in concrete terms.

column3: To establish firmly something such as a system, a goal or a position: 确立目标 "set a goal", 确立地位 "establish one's position", 确立关系. The object is abstract, and the word suggests it is settled for good. 确 "firm" + 立 "set up".
column4: 我们已经确立了今年的目标。
column5: 我們已經確立了今年的目標。
column6: Wǒmen yǐjīng quèlì le jīnnián de mùbiāo.
column7: We have already established this year's goals.

column3: To control or keep within bounds: 控制情绪 "control one's emotions", 控制体重 "keep one's weight in check", 失去控制 "lose control". It is used for feelings, spread, size and machines. 控 "control" + 制 "restrain".
column4: 他努力控制自己的情绪。
column5: 他努力控制自己的情緒。
column6: Tā nǔlì kòngzhì zìjǐ de qíngxù.
column7: He tries hard to control his emotions.

column3: To play a role or to have an effect, always with 作用: 起到作用 "have an effect", 起到重要作用 "play an important role", 起到了很好的效果. The pattern is 起到 + (adjective +) 作用 / 效果, in written style. 起 "bring about" + 到 "achieve".
column4: 这些措施起到了很好的作用。
column5: 這些措施起到了很好的作用。
column6: Zhèxiē cuòshī qǐdào le hěn hǎo de zuòyòng.
column7: These measures played a very good role.

column3: To expect or anticipate, and the expectation itself: 预期目标 "expected target", 达到预期 "meet expectations", 超出预期 "exceed expectations". It is formal and about results and figures. 预 "in advance" + 期 "expect".
column4: 这次活动的效果超出了我们的预期。
column5: 這次活動的效果超出了我們的預期。
column6: Zhè cì huódòng de xiàoguǒ chāochū le wǒmen de yùqī.
column7: The result of this event exceeded our expectations.

column3: To try something to see how it turns out: 尝试新方法 "try a new method", 勇于尝试 "dare to try", and also a noun, "an attempt". It suggests experimenting. 尝 "taste" + 试 "try". It is not for "try on", which is 试穿.
column4: 我想尝试一种新的学习方法。
column5: 我想嘗試一種新的學習方法。
column6: Wǒ xiǎng chángshì yī zhǒng xīn de xuéxí fāngfǎ.
column7: I want to try a new way of studying.

column3: The key point or the deciding factor, and as an adjective "crucial": 关键问题 "the crucial issue", 关键时刻 "the critical moment", 关键在于… "the key lies in…". 在关键时刻 is a common phrase. 关 "gate, pass" + 键 "key (of a lock or keyboard)", so the word is a pass that must be got through.
column4: 学好语言的关键在于多练习。
column5: 學好語言的關鍵在於多練習。
column6: Xuéhǎo yǔyán de guānjiàn zàiyú duō liànxí.
column7: The key to learning a language well lies in practicing a lot.

column3: A link in a chain, a stage or part of a process: 关键环节 "key step", 薄弱环节 "weak link", 每个环节 "every stage". It is used for the parts of a process that depend on one another. 环 "ring" + 节 "joint", like links in a chain.
column4: 生产的每一个环节都要检查。
column5: 生產的每一個環節都要檢查。
column6: Shēngchǎn de měi yī ge huánjié dōu yào jiǎnchá.
column7: Every stage of production has to be checked.

column3: A precondition or premise: 在…的前提下 "on the condition that…", 前提条件 "prerequisite", 以…为前提. The pattern 在 + condition + 的前提下 states the basis on which something is done. 前 "before" + 提 "put forward".
column4: 在保证安全的前提下，我们可以开始工作。
column5: 在保證安全的前提下，我們可以開始工作。
column6: Zài bǎozhèng ānquán de qiántí xià, wǒmen kěyǐ kāishǐ gōngzuò.
column7: On condition that safety is ensured, we can start work.

column3: Prospects, the outlook for the future: 发展前景 "development prospects", 前景广阔 "a bright outlook", 市场前景. The adjective that follows it is positive or negative: 前景很好 / 前景暗淡. It can also be the foreground of a picture. 前 "front, ahead" + 景 "scene".
column4: 这个行业的发展前景很好。
column5: 這個行業的發展前景很好。
column6: Zhège hángyè de fāzhǎn qiánjǐng hěn hǎo.
column7: The prospects for this industry are very good.

column3: An outline or syllabus: 教学大纲 "teaching syllabus", 考试大纲 "exam outline", 写大纲 "draft an outline". It is a summary of the main points of a course or text. 大 "main" + 纲 "outline, key link"; 纲 has 纟 (thread) as its meaning part, so it is a thread that holds things together.
column4: 写文章之前，先列一个大纲。
column5: 寫文章之前，先列一個大綱。
column6: Xiě wénzhāng zhīqián, xiān liè yī ge dàgāng.
column7: Before you write an article, first draw up an outline.

column3: A pattern, model or mode: 工作模式 "work mode", 生活模式, 商业模式 "business model". It is also the mode of a device: 飞行模式 "airplane mode". It names a fixed way of doing or arranging things. 模 "model" + 式 "style".
column6: Shǒujī jìnrù le fēixíng móshì.
column7: The phone has gone into airplane mode.

column3: A mechanism, in the sense of how a system works: 市场机制 "market mechanism", 运行机制 "operating mechanism", 激励机制 "incentive scheme". It is used for organizations, processes and bodies rather than for a machine. The other word 机制, "machine-made", as in 机制纸, is rare and read the same.
column4: 学校建立了新的奖励机制。
column5: 學校建立了新的獎勵機制。
column6: Xuéxiào jiànlì le xīn de jiǎnglì jīzhì.
column7: The school set up a new reward scheme.

column3: A situation or state of affairs, usually a big one that is changing: 局面稳定 "the situation is stable", 打开局面 "open up new ground", 僵持的局面 "a deadlock". It covers a whole scene at a given moment, as in a game of chess. 局 "board, situation" + 面 "side".
column4: 双方的比赛出现了僵持的局面。
column5: 雙方的比賽出現了僵持的局面。
column6: Shuāngfāng de bǐsài chūxiàn le jiāngchí de júmiàn.
column7: The match between the two sides reached a stalemate.

column3: A scene or spectacle, what is seen at an event: 热闹的场面 "a lively scene", 感人的场面 "a moving scene", 大场面 "a grand occasion". It is about what is happening in front of you, and 场面话 are polite words said for form's sake. 场 "place" + 面 "face".
column4: 婚礼上的场面非常感人。
column5: 婚禮上的場面非常感人。
column6: Hūnlǐ shàng de chǎngmiàn fēicháng gǎnrén.
column7: The scene at the wedding was very moving.

column3: A situation or circumstances: 这种情形 "this kind of situation", 在这种情形下 "under such circumstances", 当时的情形 "how things were then". The second syllable is neutral. It is like 情况 but a little more written. 情 "state" + 形 "shape".
column4: 在这种情形下，你最好别说话。
column5: 在這種情形下，你最好別說話。
column6: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngxing xià, nǐ zuìhǎo bié shuōhuà.
column7: In a situation like this, it is best that you say nothing.

column3: Form, shape or state, as in a scientific or abstract sense: 物质形态 "form of matter", 意识形态 "ideology", 语言形态. It is about how something takes shape. 形 "shape" + 态 "state, bearing".
column4: 水有三种形态：固态、液态和气态。
column5: 水有三種形態：固態、液態和氣態。
column6: Shuǐ yǒu sān zhǒng xíngtài: gùtài, yètài hé qìtài.
column7: Water has three forms: solid, liquid and gas.

column3: A level or layer, and also the order of ideas in a text: 不同层次 "different levels", 层次分明 "clearly structured", 文章的层次. It is used for both a structure with steps and the quality of something. 层 "layer" + 次 "order".
column4: 这篇文章写得层次分明。
column5: 這篇文章寫得層次分明。
column6: Zhè piān wénzhāng xiě de céngcì fēnmíng.
column7: This article is written with a clear structure.

column3: A style, type or form: 中式 "Chinese style", 西式 "Western style", 老式 "old-fashioned", 新式. It is a suffix that follows a word to describe the style: 日式料理 "Japanese-style cuisine". It also appears in 公式 "formula" and 仪式 "ceremony".
column4: 我喜欢中式的装修风格。
column5: 我喜歡中式的裝修風格。
column6: Wǒ xǐhuan zhōngshì de zhuāngxiū fēnggé.
column7: I like the Chinese style of decoration.

column3: Rotten, messy, ruined: 糟了 "oh no", 乱七八糟 "in a mess", 糟蹋 "to waste", 糟糕. 糟了 is a spoken cry when something has gone wrong. Alone it can mean dregs left from making wine, and the 米 on the left is grain.
column6: Zāo le, wǒ wàng le dài yàoshi.
column7: Oh no, I forgot to bring my keys.

column3: Terrible, bad, or an exclamation "oh no!": 糟糕的天气 "awful weather", 真糟糕 "how awful", 糟糕，迟到了 "damn, I'm late". 糕 is the character of 蛋糕 "cake", with 米 "rice" as its meaning part, but here the pair is a fixed word. It is used in speech and in writing.
column6: Jīntiān de tiānqì zāogāo jíle.
column7: The weather today is awful.

column3: A hole or leak, and figuratively a loophole or flaw: 法律漏洞 "legal loophole", 系统漏洞 "system bug, security hole", 堵住漏洞 "close the gap". It is the word for a security hole in software. 漏 "leak" + 洞 "hole".
column4: 这个软件有一个安全漏洞。
column5: 這個軟體有一個安全漏洞。
column6: Zhège ruǎnjiàn yǒu yī ge ānquán lòudòng.
column7: This software has a security hole.

column3: A mistake or slip, usually a lapse in carrying out a task: 工作失误 "an error at work", 操作失误 "an operating error", 减少失误. In sports it is an unforced error. It is milder than 错误 and suggests carelessness, not wrongdoing. 失 "lose" + 误 "err".
column4: 一个小失误让他们输掉了比赛。
column5: 一個小失誤讓他們輸掉了比賽。
column6: Yī ge xiǎo shīwù ràng tāmen shūdiào le bǐsài.
column7: One small slip made them lose the match.

column3: To lack or be short of something, an abstract or needed thing: 缺乏经验 "lack experience", 缺乏信心, 缺乏资金 "short of funds". It is a written word, with the missing thing as the object. 缺 "lack" + 乏 "short".
column6: Tā quēfá gōngzuò jīngyàn.
column7: He lacks work experience.

column3: To obstruct or hinder, and an obstacle: 阻碍发展 "hinder development", 阻碍交通 "block traffic", 严重的阻碍. The apostrophe marks the break before ai. It is for obstacles to progress or movement. 阻 "block" + 碍 "hinder".
column6: Dàxuě zǔ'ài le jiāotōng.
column7: The heavy snow obstructed traffic.

column3: To trouble or plague, of a problem that keeps coming back: 被问题困扰 "bothered by a problem", 失眠困扰着他 "insomnia troubles him", 带来困扰. It is also a noun, "trouble". 困 "trapped" + 扰 "disturb".
column6: Shīmián yīzhí kùnrǎo zhe tā.
column7: Insomnia has troubled him all along.

column3: Insufficient or lacking, and a shortcoming as a noun: 经验不足 "lacking experience", 资金不足, 弥补不足 "make up for shortcomings". It can also be a verb phrase, "not enough to": 不足为奇 "not surprising". The other meaning "not up to a number" is common: 不足十人.
column4: 这个项目的资金还不足。
column5: 這個項目的資金還不足。
column6: Zhège xiàngmù de zījīn hái bùzú.
column7: This project does not have enough funds yet.

column3: Unfavorable or harmful to someone: 对…不利 "bad for…", 不利条件 "unfavorable conditions", 形势不利. The usual pattern is 对 + person + 不利. The opposite is 有利. 不 "not" + 利 "benefit".
column6: Áoyè duì shēntǐ bùlì.
column7: Staying up late is bad for your health.

column3: To harm or damage something that is valuable but not physical: 损害健康 "damage health", 损害名誉 "damage a reputation", 损害利益 "harm interests". It can also be a noun, "damage". It is used for health, rights and image. 损 "lose" + 害 "harm".
column6: Xīyān huì sǔnhài nǐ de jiànkāng.
column7: Smoking harms your health.

column3: A loss, as in money, goods or time, and to lose: 经济损失 "financial loss", 损失惨重 "heavy losses", 避免损失. It is a noun in 造成损失 "cause a loss", and a verb in 损失了很多钱 "lost a lot of money". 损 "lose" + 失 "lose".
column4: 这场大火造成了巨大的损失。
column5: 這場大火造成了巨大的損失。
column6: Zhè chǎng dàhuǒ zàochéng le jùdà de sǔnshī.
column7: This big fire caused huge losses.

column3: To harm, and harm itself: 害人 "harm people", 害了他 "ruined him", 害虫 "pest", 利害 "pros and cons". In speech it also means to feel afraid or embarrassed: 害怕 "be afraid", 害羞 "be shy". The common use is as the first character of those words.
column4: 这件事害得他丢了工作。
column5: 這件事害得他丟了工作。
column6: Zhè jiàn shì hài de tā diū le gōngzuò.
column7: This matter cost him his job.

column3: Great, excellent in speech: 真棒 "great!", 你真棒 "you're awesome", 身体很棒. It is an everyday word of praise. As a noun it is a stick: 棒球 "baseball", 木棒. The 木 on the left is wood, and the word was first a wooden stick.
column6: Nǐ jīntiān de biǎoxiàn zhēn bàng!
column7: You did really great today!

column3: First-class, top-ranked: 一流大学 "top university", 世界一流 "world-class", 一流的服务. It is an adjective, and 一 is read yi1 in the dictionary form. It marks the highest grade, and 二流 and 三流 are lower grades. 流 here means "grade".
column4: 这家酒店的服务是一流的。
column5: 這家酒店的服務是一流的。
column6: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de fúwù shì yīliú de.
column7: The service of this hotel is first-class.

column3: Precious, of high value for rarity, history or feeling: 珍贵的礼物 "a precious gift", 珍贵文物 "precious relics", 珍贵的回忆. It usually modifies a noun. 珍 "treasure" + 贵 "costly". The 王 on the left of 珍 is jade, since it first meant a gemstone.
column4: 这张照片对我来说非常珍贵。
column5: 這張照片對我來說非常珍貴。
column6: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn duì wǒ lái shuō fēicháng zhēnguì.
column7: This photo is very precious to me.

column3: To treasure and take care not to waste: 珍惜时间 "treasure time", 珍惜机会 "cherish a chance", 珍惜友谊. It is a verb of attitude toward something one has. 珍 "treasure" + 惜 "cherish". Unlike 珍贵, it takes an object.
column4: 我们要珍惜现在拥有的一切。
column5: 我們要珍惜現在擁有的一切。
column6: Wǒmen yào zhēnxī xiànzài yōngyǒu de yīqiè.
column7: We should cherish everything we have now.

column3: A pearl: 一颗珍珠 "a pearl", 珍珠项链 "pearl necklace", 珍珠奶茶 "bubble tea". Both characters have 王 on the left, where 王 is the form of 玉 jade in compounds, a sign that they are gems. Taiwan's bubble tea is called 珍珠奶茶.
column6: Tā dài zhe yī tiáo zhēnzhū xiàngliàn.
column7: She wears a pearl necklace.

column3: Strong, forceful, powerful, of speech, evidence or support: 有力的证据 "strong evidence", 强劲有力 "vigorous", 有力的支持. It is usually before a noun and stresses how convincing or effective something is. 有 "have" + 力 "strength".
column4: 警察找到了有力的证据。
column5: 警察找到了有力的證據。
column6: Jǐngchá zhǎodào le yǒulì de zhèngjù.
column7: The police found strong evidence.

column3: To take priority: 优先考虑 "give priority to", 优先权 "right of way", 老人优先 "the elderly first". It is used as a verb or before another verb. 优 "excellent" + 先 "first".
column4: 在这里，老人和孩子优先。
column5: 在這裡，老人和孩子優先。
column6: Zài zhèlǐ, lǎorén hé háizi yōuxiān.
column7: Here, the elderly and children have priority.

column3: Magical, marvelous, miraculous: 神奇的力量 "a magical power", 神奇的故事, 很神奇. It is used for things so surprising they seem beyond ordinary. It is positive. 神 "god, spirit" + 奇 "strange".
column4: 这个小岛上有一种神奇的花。
column5: 這個小島上有一種神奇的花。
column6: Zhège xiǎodǎo shàng yǒu yī zhǒng shénqí de huā.
column7: On this small island there is a magical kind of flower.

column3: A model or exemplary person: 劳动模范 "model worker", 模范教师, 模范作用 "a role-model effect". It is a title and used before a noun. 模 "model" + 范 "pattern". It is read mo2 here, as in 模型.
column4: 他被评为这个月的模范员工。
column5: 他被評為這個月的模範員工。
column6: Tā bèi píngwéi zhège yuè de mófàn yuángōng.
column7: He was chosen as this month's model employee.

column3: Good luck: 祝你好运 "good luck", 交好运 "have good luck", 带来好运. As a wish it is 祝你好运. The word 运 alone is "luck, fortune". 好 "good" + 运 "luck".
column6: Zhù nǐ kǎoshì hǎoyùn!
column7: Good luck on your exam!

column3: Glorious or honorable, and honor itself: 光荣的任务 "a glorious task", 感到光荣 "feel honored", 光荣传统 "proud tradition". It is used for deeds that deserve public respect, and is more official than 骄傲. 光 "light" + 荣 "honor".
column4: 当医生是一件光荣的事。
column5: 當醫生是一件光榮的事。
column6: Dāng yīshēng shì yī jiàn guāngróng de shì.
column7: Being a doctor is an honorable thing.

column3: Preferential or discounted, and a special offer: 优惠价格 "discount price", 优惠活动 "promotion", 享受优惠 "enjoy a discount". It is the word on shop signs and tickets. 优 "excellent" + 惠 "favor".
column4: 这家商店今天有优惠活动。
column5: 這家商店今天有優惠活動。
column6: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn jīntiān yǒu yōuhuì huódòng.
column7: This shop has a special offer today.

column3: Good value, of a price or a deal, and tangible benefit: 价格实惠 "reasonably priced", 又好又实惠 "good and cheap", 得到实惠 "get a real benefit". It praises things for being practical and not costing much. 实 "real" + 惠 "benefit".
column4: 这家餐厅的菜又好吃又实惠。
column5: 這家餐廳的菜又好吃又實惠。
column6: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài yòu hǎochī yòu shíhuì.
column7: The food at this restaurant is both tasty and good value.

column3: Matter or material, as against mind, and material things: 物质生活 "material life", 物质文明, 物质条件. The opposite is 精神. It is also used for a chemical substance: 有害物质 "harmful substances". 物 "thing" + 质 "substance".
column4: 他们的物质生活越来越丰富。
column5: 他們的物質生活越來越豐富。
column6: Tāmen de wùzhì shēnghuó yuè lái yuè fēngfù.
column7: Their material life is getting richer and richer.

column3: Energy in the physical sense, and the strength a person or thing has: 太阳能量 "solar energy", 补充能量 "restore energy", 正能量 "positive energy". 正能量 is now a common phrase for an uplifting attitude. 能 "ability" + 量 "amount".
column4: 食物给我们的身体提供能量。
column5: 食物給我們的身體提供能量。
column6: Shíwù gěi wǒmen de shēntǐ tígōng néngliàng.
column7: Food provides energy for our bodies.

column3: Heat, and calories in food: 热量高 "high in calories", 控制热量 "control calories", 释放热量 "release heat". It is the everyday word on diets and the physics word for the quantity of heat. 热 "hot" + 量 "amount".
column6: Zhè zhǒng shíwù de rèliàng hěn gāo.
column7: This food is high in calories.

column3: Natural gas: 使用天然气 "use natural gas", 天然气管道 "gas pipeline", 液化天然气. It is a fuel used for cooking, heating and power. 天然 "natural" + 气 "gas".
column6: Wǒmen jiā yòng tiānránqì zuòfàn.
column7: Our home cooks with natural gas.

column3: A gas, a substance in gaseous form: 有毒气体 "toxic gas", 气体和液体 "gases and liquids", 排放气体. It names the state of matter. 气 "gas, air" + 体 "body, form". Compare 液体 and 固体.
column6: Zhè zhǒng qìtǐ duì réntǐ yǒuhài.
column7: This gas is harmful to the human body.

column3: Friction or rubbing, and conflict between people: 产生摩擦 "produce friction", 摩擦力 "frictional force", 发生摩擦 "have a falling-out". The figurative sense is for small disputes between neighbors, countries or colleagues. Both 摩 and 擦 mean "rub", so the word is a doubled verb.
column4: 两只手互相摩擦会发热。
column5: 兩隻手互相摩擦會發熱。
column6: Liǎng zhī shǒu hùxiāng mócā huì fārè.
column7: Rubbing two hands together makes heat.

column3: To vibrate or shake, and vibration: 手机振动 "the phone vibrates", 振动模式, 声音由振动产生 "sound comes from vibration". It describes regular back-and-forth movement. 振 "shake" + 动 "move".
column6: Wǒ de shǒujī yīzhí zài zhèndòng.
column7: My phone keeps vibrating.

column3: To launch or fire, as a rocket, missile, or signal: 发射火箭 "launch a rocket", 发射信号 "send a signal", 发射台 "launch pad". It is used for anything sent out into the air or space. 发 "send out" + 射 "shoot".
column4: 火箭将在明天早上发射。
column5: 火箭將在明天早上發射。
column6: Huǒjiàn jiāng zài míngtiān zǎoshang fāshè.
column7: The rocket will be launched tomorrow morning.

column3: To run or operate, of a machine, a system, or a route: 系统运行正常 "the system is running normally", 列车运行 "trains run", 运行速度. It is also used for the orbit of a planet. 运 "move" + 行 "go".
column4: 这台机器已经连续运行了十个小时。
column5: 這台機器已經連續運行了十個小時。
column6: Zhè tái jīqì yǐjīng liánxù yùnxíng le shí ge xiǎoshí.
column7: This machine has been running for ten hours without stopping.

column3: Volume, the space an object takes up: 体积大 "bulky", 体积小 "small in size", 计算体积 "calculate the volume". Not for capacity, which is 容量. 体 "body" + 积 "accumulate", so the size of a body.
column4: 这个箱子体积太大，放不进车里。
column5: 這個箱子體積太大，放不進車裡。
column6: Zhège xiāngzi tǐjī tài dà, fàng bù jìn chē lǐ.
column7: This box is too big to fit in the car.

column3: The water content, moisture: 含水分 "contains water", 补充水分 "replenish water", 水分充足. It is the water in a fruit, a skin or the soil. Figuratively it means padding or exaggeration, as in 数据有水分 "the data is padded". The second syllable is read fen4 here.
column4: 皮肤需要经常补充水分。
column5: 皮膚需要經常補充水分。
column6: Pífū xūyào jīngcháng bǔchōng shuǐfèn.
column7: Skin needs to have water added often.

column3: Performance or quality of a machine or product: 性能好 "performs well", 手机性能 "phone performance", 性能稳定 "stable performance". It measures how well a device works, and it is the word in product specs. 性 "nature" + 能 "ability".
column6: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī de xìngnéng hěn hǎo.
column7: This phone performs very well.

column3: Standard, official, regular, following proper rules: 正规医院 "a proper hospital", 正规渠道 "official channels", 正规公司. It is used as a modifier and says something is legitimate and reliable. 正 "correct" + 规 "rule".
column6: Qǐng dào zhèngguī de yīyuàn kànbìng.
column7: Please go to a proper hospital for treatment.

column3: In common use, usable everywhere: 通用语言 "common language", 通用货币 "common currency", 全国通用 "valid nationwide". It describes tickets, cards, rules and languages that work in many places. 通 "through" + 用 "use".
column6: Zhè zhǒng kǎ zài quánguó tōngyòng.
column7: This kind of card is valid throughout the country.

column3: Popular and in demand, hot: 热门话题 "hot topic", 热门专业 "popular major", 热门景点 "popular sight". The opposite is 冷门. 热 "hot" + 门 "door, field", so a field that many people enter.
column4: 计算机是现在最热门的专业之一。
column5: 計算機是現在最熱門的專業之一。
column6: Jìsuànjī shì xiànzài zuì rèmén de zhuānyè zhī yī.
column7: Computing is one of the most popular majors now.

column3: Private or personal, of a person, not public: 私人电话 "a private call", 私人财产 "private property", 私人生活, 私人教练 "personal trainer". It contrasts with 公共 and 公家. 私 "private" + 人 "person".
column4: 这是我的私人电话，请不要告诉别人。
column5: 這是我的私人電話，請不要告訴別人。
column6: Zhè shì wǒ de sīrén diànhuà, qǐng bù yào gàosu biéren.
column7: This is my private number; please do not tell anyone.

column3: Sufficient or abundant: 阳光充足 "plenty of sunshine", 资金充足 "ample funds", 睡眠充足 "enough sleep". It describes things that are enough or more than enough, and it is stronger than 够. 充 "fill" + 足 "enough".
column4: 这里阳光充足，适合种花。
column5: 這裡陽光充足，適合種花。
column6: Zhèlǐ yángguāng chōngzú, shìhé zhòng huā.
column7: There is plenty of sunshine here, which suits growing flowers.

column3: Convenient, and to make convenient: 交通便利 "with convenient transport", 便利店 "convenience store", 为…提供便利 "make things easy for…". It is written and common in ads for homes and services. 便 is read bian4 here.
column6: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng fēicháng biànlì.
column7: Transport here is very convenient.

column3: Specific or particular, set aside for a case: 特定的时间 "a particular time", 特定人群 "a particular group", 在特定情况下 "under certain circumstances". It points to one defined item among several, in a formal tone. 特 "special" + 定 "fixed".
column4: 这种药只适用于特定的人群。
column5: 這種藥只適用於特定的人群。
column6: Zhè zhǒng yào zhǐ shìyòng yú tèdìng de rénqún.
column7: This medicine is only suitable for a particular group of people.

column3: A characteristic or property of a thing: 物理特性 "physical property", 具有特性 "has the property", 特性不同. It is used for natural or built-in features of materials or species. 特 "special" + 性 "nature".
column4: 每种金属都有自己的特性。
column5: 每種金屬都有自己的特性。
column6: Měi zhǒng jīnshǔ dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèxìng.
column7: Every metal has its own characteristics.

column3: Unique to, characteristic of: 中国特有的动物 "an animal unique to China", 特有的风格 "a distinctive style", 这座城市特有的味道. It goes before 的 and a noun, and marks something found in a particular place or in a person. 特 "special" + 有 "have".
column4: 大熊猫是中国特有的动物。
column5: 大熊貓是中國特有的動物。
column6: Dàxióngmāo shì Zhōngguó tèyǒu de dòngwù.
column7: The giant panda is an animal unique to China.

column3: Sound, complete and working well, of a system or body: 制度健全 "a sound system", 身心健全 "healthy in body and mind", 健全法律 "improve the laws". It is also a verb, "to perfect". 健 "healthy" + 全 "whole".
column4: 公司需要建立健全的管理制度。
column5: 公司需要建立健全的管理制度。
column6: Gōngsī xūyào jiànlì jiànquán de guǎnlǐ zhìdù.
column7: The company needs to set up a sound management system.

column3: Complete, with everything one needs: 品种齐全 "a full range of products", 设备齐全 "fully equipped", 手续齐全. It is commonly used to describe shops, kits or documents. 齐 "all in order" + 全 "whole".
column4: 这家超市的商品种类很齐全。
column5: 這家超市的商品種類很齊全。
column6: Zhè jiā chāoshì de shāngpǐn zhǒnglèi hěn qíquán.
column7: This supermarket has a full range of goods.

column3: Generally acknowledged: 公认的事实 "a recognized fact", 被公认为 "is widely regarded as". A passive pattern is common: 被公认为…. It is for things that everybody agrees to. 公 "public" + 认 "recognize".
column4: 他被公认为这个领域最好的专家。
column5: 他被公認為這個領域最好的專家。
column6: Tā bèi gōngrèn wéi zhège lǐngyù zuì hǎo de zhuānjiā.
column7: He is generally recognized as the best expert in this field.

column3: Laws and regulations: 法律法规 "laws and regulations", 遵守法规 "obey the regulations", 行业法规. It is the collective term for rules made by a legislature or government. 法 "law" + 规 "regulation".
column4: 公司必须遵守相关的法规。
column5: 公司必須遵守相關的法規。
column6: Gōngsī bìxū zūnshǒu xiāngguān de fǎguī.
column7: The company must comply with the relevant regulations.

column3: The legal system, rule by law: 法制社会 "a society under law", 加强法制 "strengthen the legal system", 法制教育. It refers to the system and the principle together. Not to be confused with 法治 "rule of law", read the same: fǎzhì.
column6: Wǒmen yào jiāqiáng fǎzhì jiàoyù.
column7: We should strengthen education on the legal system.

column3: Illegal or to break the law: 违法行为 "illegal acts", 违法乱纪, 这样做是违法的 "doing this is illegal". It is a verb-object word, so it can be split: 违了法. It is stronger than 违规. 违 "go against" + 法 "law".
column6: Zài zhèlǐ tíngchē shì wéifǎ de.
column7: It is illegal to park here.

column3: To violate a rule, law or agreement: 违反规定 "break the rules", 违反合同 "breach a contract", 违反交通规则 "violate traffic rules". The object is the rule, and this word takes an object, unlike 违法. 违 "go against" + 反 "against".
column6: Tā wéifǎn le xuéxiào de guīdìng.
column7: He broke the school's rules.

column3: To break the rules, a rule that is not a law: 违规操作 "improper operation", 违规停车 "illegal parking", 违规行为. It is a verb-object word and common in news about sports, business and traffic. 违 "go against" + 规 "rule".
column4: 这名选手因为违规被取消了成绩。
column5: 這名選手因為違規被取消了成績。
column6: Zhè míng xuǎnshǒu yīnwèi wéiguī bèi qǔxiāo le chéngjì.
column7: This athlete had the result canceled for breaking the rules.

column3: To punish, or a punishment, from an authority: 受到处罚 "be punished", 行政处罚 "administrative penalty", 处罚违规者. It is for fines, bans and formal sanctions. 处 "deal with" + 罚 "penalize", read chu3 here.
column6: Luàn rēng lājī huì shòudào chǔfá.
column7: Throwing litter around will be punished.

column3: Disciplinary action, or to discipline someone: 受处分 "receive a disciplinary action", 给他一个处分 "give him a reprimand", 警告处分. It is used for schools, companies and government bodies. 处 is read chu3 here.
column4: 他因为作弊受到了处分。
column5: 他因為作弊受到了處分。
column6: Tā yīnwèi zuòbì shòudào le chǔfèn.
column7: He was disciplined for cheating.

column3: In accordance with the law: 依法办事 "act according to law", 依法处理, 依法纳税 "pay taxes as the law requires". It comes before the verb as an adverb and is used in formal and official text. 依 "according to" + 法 "law".
column6: Gōngmín dōu yào yīfǎ nàshuì.
column7: All citizens must pay taxes according to the law.

column3: Public order, law and order in a place: 治安好 "a safe area", 维护治安 "maintain public order", 治安管理. It is the word used about how safe a neighborhood or city is. The apostrophe separates zhi4 from an1. 治 "govern" + 安 "peaceful".
column6: Zhège chéngshì de zhì'ān hěn hǎo.
column7: Law and order is good in this city.

column3: To govern or to manage and clean up: 治理国家 "govern a country", 治理污染 "control pollution", 治理环境. It is used for large problems such as water, air or a region, needing a plan over time. 治 "govern, cure" + 理 "manage".
column4: 政府正在治理河水污染。
column5: 政府正在治理河水污染。
column6: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài zhìlǐ héshuǐ wūrǎn.
column7: The government is dealing with the pollution of the river.

column3: To abide by a rule, law or promise: 遵守规则 "follow the rules", 遵守交通规则 "obey traffic rules", 遵守诺言 "keep a promise". The object is always something set in advance. 遵 "follow" + 守 "keep".
column4: 大家都要遵守交通规则。
column5: 大家都要遵守交通規則。
column6: Dàjiā dōu yào zūnshǒu jiāotōng guīzé.
column7: Everyone must obey the traffic rules.

column3: To obey or submit to a person or an order: 服从命令 "obey orders", 服从安排 "accept the arrangement", 少数服从多数 "the minority yields to the majority". It means one gives way to authority. 服 "submit" + 从 "follow". It is a firmer word than 听.
column6: Shìbīng bìxū fúcóng mìnglìng.
column7: Soldiers must obey orders.

column3: To restrict or bind someone's behavior, and a restraint: 约束自己 "restrain oneself", 受到约束 "be bound", 没有约束 "without restraint". It can be a rule that limits action or self-discipline. 约 "bind, agree" + 束 "tie".
column6: Háizi xūyào jiāzhǎng de yuēshù.
column7: Children need their parents' restraint.

column3: To restrict or limit, as a factor: 相互制约 "limit each other", 受到制约 "be constrained", 制约发展 "hold back development". It is mostly about conditions and relations in a system, not a person's control. 制 "restrain" + 约 "bind".
column4: 经济条件制约着学校的发展。
column5: 經濟條件制約著學校的發展。
column6: Jīngjì tiáojiàn zhìyuē zhe xuéxiào de fāzhǎn.
column7: Economic conditions limit the school's development.

column3: Not allowed, must not: 不许说话 "no talking", 不许迟到 "you must not be late", 不许动. It is a direct prohibition from someone with authority. 不 is read bu4 in the dictionary form. It is stronger than 不可以 and sounds like a command.
column4: 上课的时候不许玩手机。
column5: 上課的時候不許玩手機。
column6: Shàngkè de shíhou bùxǔ wán shǒujī.
column7: You are not allowed to play with your phone in class.

column3: Fair, impartial: 公正的判决 "a fair ruling", 公平公正, 公正地对待 "treat fairly". It is for judges, referees and decisions that favor no one. 公 "public" + 正 "upright".
column6: Fǎguān de pànjué gōngzhèng hélǐ.
column7: The judge's ruling is fair and reasonable.

column3: Justice, and just: 伸张正义 "uphold justice", 正义感 "sense of justice", 正义的事业 "a just cause". It is a moral term for what is right in society. 正 "upright" + 义 "righteousness".
column6: Wǒmen yào wèi zhèngyì ér zhàn.
column7: We must fight for justice.

column3: The center, and the central government: 广场中央 "the middle of the square", 中央政府 "the central government", 党中央. Both meanings are common: a physical middle and the highest authority. 央 also means "center" in this word.
column6: Guǎngchǎng zhōngyāng yǒu yī zuò pēnquán.
column7: There is a fountain in the middle of the square.

column3: Nationality, the country someone belongs to legally: 你是哪国国籍 "what is your nationality", 加入国籍, 双重国籍 "dual nationality". It is the term on forms and passports. 国 "country" + 籍 "register".
column6: Tā yǒu liǎng ge guójiā de guójí.
column7: He holds nationality of two countries.

column3: A superior, a higher level of authority: 上级领导 "superior officials", 向上级汇报 "report to the higher-ups", 听从上级. The opposite is 下级. It means the people or body above you in the chain of command. 上 "up" + 级 "rank".
column4: 这件事需要先向上级报告。
column5: 這件事需要先向上級報告。
column6: Zhè jiàn shì xūyào xiān xiàng shàngjí bàogào.
column7: This matter has to be reported to a superior first.

column3: Power or influence, and a political or military force: 势力范围 "sphere of influence", 恶势力 "the forces of evil", 扩大势力. The second syllable is neutral. It can be negative, since it often names groups that use power. 势 "power" + 力 "force".
column4: 这个组织的势力越来越大。
column5: 這個組織的勢力越來越大。
column6: Zhège zǔzhī de shìli yuè lái yuè dà.
column7: This organization is getting more and more influential.

column3: A position, a standpoint on an issue: 站在…的立场 "from the standpoint of…", 坚持立场 "stick to one's position", 政治立场. The pattern 站在他的立场上 means putting oneself in someone's place. 立 "stand" + 场 "place".
column4: 请你站在我的立场想一想。
column5: 請你站在我的立場想一想。
column6: Qǐng nǐ zhàn zài wǒ de lìchǎng xiǎng yī xiǎng.
column7: Please think about it from my point of view.

column3: A group or community sharing something: 年轻群体 "the young as a group", 特殊群体 "special groups", 群体活动 "group activity". It names the group as a whole, either people or animals. 群 "crowd" + 体 "body".
column4: 年轻人是这家店的主要消费群体。
column5: 年輕人是這家店的主要消費群體。
column6: Niánqīngrén shì zhè jiā diàn de zhǔyào xiāofèi qúntǐ.
column7: Young people are this shop's main group of customers.

column3: A society, organization or agency, found in compounds: 社会 "society", 报社 "newspaper office", 出版社 "publishing house", 旅行社 "travel agency". It is a bound character. It is built from 礻 (spirit) and 土 (earth), the spirit of the land, which is how it came to mean a gathering of people.
column4: 我的姐姐在一家出版社工作。
column5: 我的姐姐在一家出版社工作。
column6: Wǒ de jiějie zài yī jiā chūbǎnshè gōngzuò.
column7: My older sister works at a publishing house.

column3: To carry out or promote a policy, system or practice widely: 推行新政策 "implement a new policy", 推行改革 "push through reform", 推行普通话 "promote Mandarin". The object is a policy or program, not a person. 推 "push" + 行 "carry out".
column4: 政府在全国推行新的教育政策。
column5: 政府在全國推行新的教育政策。
column6: Zhèngfǔ zài quánguó tuīxíng xīn de jiàoyù zhèngcè.
column7: The government is carrying out a new education policy across the country.

column3: To reform, and a reform: 经济改革 "economic reform", 教育改革, 改革开放 "reform and opening up". It means a deep change to an existing system, larger than 改变. 改 "change" + 革 "remove, reform".
column4: 这个国家正在进行教育改革。
column5: 這個國家正在進行教育改革。
column6: Zhège guójiā zhèngzài jìnxíng jiàoyù gǎigé.
column7: This country is carrying out education reform.

column3: To lead or dominate, as a main force: 主导地位 "leading position", 主导作用 "leading role", 由…主导 "led by…". It also appears as an adjective before a noun. 主 "main" + 导 "lead".
column4: 这个项目由年轻人主导。
column5: 這個項目由年輕人主導。
column6: Zhège xiàngmù yóu niánqīngrén zhǔdǎo.
column7: This project is led by young people.

column3: The main part or body of something, and the subject or agent: 建筑主体 "the main structure of a building", 市场主体 "market players", 主体意识. It tells which part is the core. 主 "main" + 体 "body".
column4: 这座桥的主体已经完工。
column5: 這座橋的主體已經完工。
column6: Zhè zuò qiáo de zhǔtǐ yǐjīng wángōng.
column7: The main structure of the bridge has been completed.

column3: The human world, the earth, as against heaven: 人间天堂 "heaven on earth", 来到人间 "come into the world", 人间烟火 "the daily life of mortals". It is a literary word and appears in poetry. 人 "person" + 间 "among".
column6: Hángzhōu bèi chēngwéi rénjiān tiāntáng.
column7: Hangzhou is called heaven on earth.

column3: Morality or ethics, and moral: 道德标准 "moral standard", 职业道德 "professional ethics", 不道德 "immoral". It describes the principles of right and wrong that a society accepts. 道 "way" + 德 "virtue".
column6: Zhèyàng zuò bù fúhé dàodé.
column7: Doing it this way goes against morality.

column3: A symbol, and to symbolize: 和平的象征 "a symbol of peace", 象征着 "symbolizes", 象征意义 "symbolic meaning". It links an object to the idea it stands for. 象 "image" + 征 "sign".
column6: Gēzi shì hépíng de xiàngzhēng.
column7: The dove is a symbol of peace.

column3: To be elected: 当选为班长 "be elected class monitor", 当选总统 "be elected president", 高票当选 "elected by a large majority". It is intransitive and the post follows. 当 "be, serve as" + 选 "elect", read dang1 here.
column6: Tā gāopiào dāngxuǎn wéi bānzhǎng.
column7: He was elected class monitor with a large majority.

column3: A title or honorary name: 荣誉称号 "honorary title", 获得称号 "win a title", 冠军称号. It is awarded for merit or fame. 称 "call" + 号 "name".
column4: 她获得了“优秀教师”的称号。
column5: 她獲得了「優秀教師」的稱號。
column6: Tā huòdé le “yōuxiù jiàoshī” de chēnghào.
column7: She was given the title of "excellent teacher".

column3: To defend and guard, a country, home or rights, against attack: 保卫国家 "defend the country", 保卫家园 "defend one's homeland", 保卫和平. It is for serious defense and sounds stirring. 保 "protect" + 卫 "guard".
column4: 士兵们誓死保卫自己的家园。
column5: 士兵們誓死保衛自己的家園。
column6: Shìbīngmen shìsǐ bǎowèi zìjǐ de jiāyuán.
column7: The soldiers vowed to defend their homeland to the death.

column3: To surround or encircle: 被包围 "be surrounded", 包围敌人 "surround the enemy", 被群山包围 "ringed by mountains". It is used for troops, crowds and places. 包 "wrap" + 围 "enclose".
column6: Xiǎo cūnzi bèi qúnshān bāowéi zhe.
column7: The small village is surrounded by mountains.

column3: A serviceman or soldier: 退伍军人 "veteran", 一名军人 "a soldier", 军人的责任. It is used for members of the armed forces of any rank. 军 "army" + 人 "person".
column6: Tā shì yī míng guāngróng de jūnrén.
column7: He is a glorious soldier.

column3: To occupy or seize by force a place: 占领城市 "occupy a city", 占领市场 "capture a market", 被占领. It is military, and is also used for taking a market share. 占 "occupy" + 领 "take over". Read zhan4 here.
column6: Dírén zhànlǐng le zhè zuò chéngshì.
column7: The enemy occupied this city.

column3: A bullet: 一颗子弹 "a bullet", 子弹上膛 "load a round", 防弹 "bulletproof". It has 弹 read dan4, "bullet" here, unlike dan2 "to flick" or "play". 子 "small thing" + 弹 "pellet".
column6: Yī kē zǐdàn dǎzhòng le qiáng.
column7: A bullet hit the wall.

column3: A gun or rifle, and a spear: 开枪 "fire a gun", 手枪 "pistol", 一把枪 "a gun", 枪声 "the sound of a shot". The measure word is 把, and for shots it is 枪. The 木 on the left is wood, since the spear had a wooden shaft.
column6: Jǐngchá shǒu lǐ názhe yī bǎ qiāng.
column7: The policeman holds a gun in his hand.

column3: To kill: 杀人 "kill someone", 杀鸡 "kill a chicken", 杀死 "kill, with a result", 被杀. Used after another verb it means "extremely", but that is dialect. It is a plain, direct word.
column6: Tāmen zuótiān shā le yī zhī jī.
column7: They killed a chicken yesterday.

column3: To commit suicide: 自杀事件 "a suicide case", 企图自杀 "attempt suicide", 选择自杀. It is a plain word used in news and in medicine. 自 "self" + 杀 "kill".
column4: 新闻报道了一起自杀事件。
column5: 新聞報導了一起自殺事件。
column6: Xīnwén bàodào le yī qǐ zìshā shìjiàn.
column7: The news reported a suicide case.

column3: Conflict or clash, of people, interests or opinions: 发生冲突 "a clash occurs", 避免冲突 "avoid conflict", 利益冲突 "conflict of interest". It is also a verb: 时间冲突 "the times conflict". 冲 "rush" + 突 "burst".
column6: Liǎng guó zhījiān fāshēng le chōngtū.
column7: A conflict broke out between the two countries.

column3: To oppose each other, or opposed: 对立的双方 "the opposing sides", 互相对立 "stand against each other", 对立面 "opposite side". It is about two things or parties placed against each other. 对 "facing" + 立 "stand".
column6: Liǎng zhǒng guāndiǎn wánquán duìlì.
column7: The two views are completely opposed.

column3: A contradiction, a conflict, and "contradictory": 内心矛盾 "inner conflict", 产生矛盾 "have a conflict", 自相矛盾 "contradict oneself". 矛 is a spear and 盾 a shield, and the story of the seller who said both could not be beaten gave the word. Also a verb: 他说得很矛盾.
column4: 他们之间产生了一些矛盾。
column5: 他們之間產生了一些矛盾。
column6: Tāmen zhījiān chǎnshēng le yīxiē máodùn.
column7: Some conflicts arose between them.

column3: To disturb or interfere with something, and interference: 干扰工作 "disturb work", 受到干扰 "be interrupted", 信号干扰 "signal interference". It is for outside forces that stop a process. 干 here is read gan1.
column6: Zàoyīn gānrǎo le wǒ de xuéxí.
column7: Noise disturbed my studying.

column3: To intervene or meddle in something: 政府干预 "government intervention", 干预内政 "interfere in internal affairs", 不要干预 "don't interfere". It can be neutral or negative depending on who intervenes. 干 is read gan1, "get involved".
column4: 家长不应该过多地干预孩子的选择。
column5: 家長不應該過多地干預孩子的選擇。
column6: Jiāzhǎng bù yīnggāi guòduō de gānyù háizi de xuǎnzé.
column7: Parents should not interfere too much in their children's choices.

column3: To lead a group, such as a team or army: 率领代表团 "lead a delegation", 率领队伍 "lead the troops". The object is a group that follows. Read shuai4 here, "lead", not lü4 "rate". It is formal.
column4: 他率领代表团访问了法国。
column5: 他率領代表團訪問了法國。
column6: Tā shuàilǐng dàibiǎotuán fǎngwèn le Fǎguó.
column7: He led the delegation on a visit to France.

column3: To liberate or set free: 解放思想 "free one's mind", 解放生产力, 解放军 "the People's Liberation Army". In the political sense, 解放 refers to the 1949 communist victory. It also means to free one's hands from drudgery: 解放双手. 解 "release" + 放 "let go".
column4: 洗衣机解放了人们的双手。
column5: 洗衣機解放了人們的雙手。
column6: Xǐyījī jiěfàng le rénmen de shuāngshǒu.
column7: The washing machine freed people's hands.

column3: Will or about to, in written style: 将来 "future", 将要 "be about to", 即将 "soon", and the structure 将…拿走, which is the written form of 把. 将 also means "general" in the other reading (jiang4), as in 将军. In this reading it is a bound form.
column4: 会议将于明天上午九点开始。
column5: 會議將於明天上午九點開始。
column6: Huìyì jiāng yú míngtiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ.
column7: The meeting will begin at nine tomorrow morning.

column3: About to, will soon: 将要毕业 "about to graduate", 将要发生 "going to happen", 就要 "about to" is the spoken form. It sits before a verb and gives a near future. It is written and a little formal.
column6: Zhè liè huǒchē jiāngyào dào zhàn le.
column7: This train is about to arrive at the station.

column3: To respond or answer, and to comply with: 应邀 "at someone's invitation", 应聘 "apply for a post", 答应 "promise", 反应 "reaction", 应付 "deal with". It is read ying4 for these; for "should" it is ying1, as in 应该. It is a bound form in compounds.
column6: Tā yìngyāo cānjiā le kāimùshì.
column7: He took part in the opening ceremony at the invitation of the organizers.

column3: Can or may, in compounds, and as a spoken emphasis: 可以 "can", 可能 "maybe", 可爱 "lovable", 可是 "but". In speech 可 adds emphasis: 你可来了 "you've finally come", 这可不行 "this really won't do".
column6: Zhè jiàn shì kě bù jiǎndān.
column7: This is really not simple.

column3: His, her, its, their, or that, in written Chinese: 其中 "among them", 其他 "other", 其实 "in fact", 其次 "next", 各得其所. It is a bound form, rarely used alone in speech. 其 stands for something said earlier, and it is the first character of many common words.
column4: 这里有五个学生，其中三个是女生。
column5: 這裡有五個學生，其中三個是女生。
column6: Zhèlǐ yǒu wǔ ge xuésheng, qízhōng sān ge shì nǚshēng.
column7: There are five students here, and three of them are girls.

column3: To arrive, until, or "most": 至少 "at least", 至今 "until now", 直至 "right up to", 至于 "as for", 甚至 "even". It is a written word, mostly used in compounds. 从…至… means "from … to …", as in 从周一至周五.
column6: Tā zhìjīn hái méiyǒu huí jiā.
column7: He has not come home until now.

column3: To make or cause, written style: 令人高兴 "makes one happy", 令人失望 "disappointing", 令人感动 "touching". The pattern is 令 + person + feeling. It also means an order, as in 命令 and 法令.
column4: 这个好消息令大家非常高兴。
column5: 這個好消息令大家非常高興。
column6: Zhège hǎo xiāoxi lìng dàjiā fēicháng gāoxìng.
column7: This good news made everybody very happy.

column3: The first of the ten Heavenly Stems, used as "A" or "first": 甲方 "Party A", 甲乙丙 "A, B, C", 甲等 "first class". It is used when naming parties in a contract or ranking. It is also the nail of a finger in 指甲 "fingernail".
column4: 甲队以二比一赢了乙队。
column5: 甲隊以二比一贏了乙隊。
column6: Jiǎ duì yǐ èr bǐ yī yíng le yǐ duì.
column7: Team A beat Team B by two to one.

column3: The second of the ten Heavenly Stems, used as "B" or "second": 乙方 "Party B", 甲乙双方 "both parties", 乙级 "grade B". In contracts, 甲方 and 乙方 are the first and second party. It is also the name of a chemical group, in 乙醇 "ethanol".
column4: 乙队在下半场进了两个球。
column5: 乙隊在下半場進了兩個球。
column6: Yǐ duì zài xià bànchǎng jìn le liǎng ge qiú.
column7: Team B scored two goals in the second half.

column3: To cause or make something happen as a result: 这使得…, 使得大家更加努力 "makes everyone work harder". The cause comes first, and the result follows. It links a cause to a changed state, in written style. 使 "make" + 得 "result".
column4: 他的努力使得全家人过上了好日子。
column5: 他的努力使得全家人過上了好日子。
column6: Tā de nǔlì shǐde quánjiārén guòshàng le hǎo rìzi.
column7: His efforts made life better for the whole family.

column3: To be able to, to be in a position to, thanks to circumstances: 得以实现 "be realized", 得以解决 "be solved", 得以进行. It always goes before a verb and does not have a person's effort as the focus. It is a formal word.
column4: 经过大家的努力，问题得以解决。
column5: 經過大家的努力，問題得以解決。
column6: Jīngguò dàjiā de nǔlì, wèntí déyǐ jiějué.
column7: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the problem was solved.

column3: To apply an action to something mentioned before, used before a two-syllable verb: 加以解释 "explain it", 加以改进 "improve it", 加以保护 "protect it". The word has no meaning alone; it makes the verb after it formal and shows that the object came before it. The verb must be more than one syllable.
column4: 对这个问题我们必须加以重视。
column5: 對這個問題我們必須加以重視。
column6: Duì zhège wèntí wǒmen bìxū jiāyǐ zhòngshì.
column7: We must pay attention to this problem.
